articleTitle: Optimization of PID Parameters Based on Ant Colony Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: In order to solve the problem that traditional PID controllers cannot easily obtain accurate models and good performance, a PID parameter optimization method based on ant colony optimization algorithm is proposed. This method analyzes the characteristics of PID parameters, combines the positive feedback mechanism of the ant colony algorithm to dynamically adjust the update strategy, optimizes the PID parameters to select the best parameters, so that the system has better performance. On the basis of the above, through use the ant colony algorithm (ACO), genetic algorithm (GA), particle swarm algorithm (PSO) to establish the mathematical model of the PID controller, and uses the algorithm to set the controller parameters. The results of the algorithm research show that the ACO has a faster convergence speed and a higher rate of convergence. It can be seen from the experiment that the optimal value of ACO is significantly better than the other two algorithms. Excellent global search capability and better robustness provide good application effects for mechanical control.

articleTitle: Traffic vehicle detection algorithm based on YOLOv3
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: Vehicle detection based on machine vision is an important part of urban intelligent transportation, and vehicle detection technology combined with deep learning is the mainstream method. In order to overcome the low detection accuracy of traditional YOLOv3 algorithm for small vehicle targets. In this paper, we add a larger convolution layer on the basis of the traditional three convolution layers of YOLOv3, and use k-means++ clustering algorithm to get 12 anchor frames again. In this method, the newly added 104*104 feature scale is more suitable for small target detection than the original feature scale of YOLOv3, and it is easier to get the global optimal anchor point by using k-means++ algorithm, so as to improve the detection accuracy. The final experimental results show that the mean average precision (mAP) of the improved YOLOv3 is 91.01%, which is 2.93% higher than that of the traditional YOLOv3.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Irrigation Water Saving Control System Based on WSN
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: Aiming at the problem of low utilization rate and low intelligent degree of agricultural irrigation water, this paper proposes a water-saving agricultural adaptive irrigation system based on WSN and intelligent communication technology. The scheme integrates the embedded system technology, ZigBee wireless networking, GPRS transmission and automatic control technology, etc. From the overall system architecture, hardware application and software design, and the operation mechanism of the whole system are explained. Then, the key technologies of each function module design, such as data acquisition, wireless transmission, Zibee development, remote monitoring and so on, are provided. Finally, the simulation test of each part of the system is performed in the laboratory environment. The test results show that the intelligent farmland irrigation water-saving control system designed in this paper has good adaptability and stability, and greatly saves agricultural water consumption.

articleTitle: LightBGM for Human Activity Recognition Using Wearable Sensors
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: Human activity recognition (HAR) has become a hot research topic, especially in the fields of vital records, adaptive tracking and health monitoring. In order to overcome the problem of low accuracy of commonly used algorithms for human recognition activities, this paper proposes a LightBGM classification method based on the UCI dataset. This method combines the user and the surrounding environment with the computer, and uses the smart phone to perceive people’s actions. It does not need to use special sensors to collect the action information in different positions of the body. It only uses the smart phone with inertial sensors to collect the action information, and carries out classification and recognition, and tests on UCI data sets. The LightGBM algorithm shows a higher accuracy rate than other algorithms and can more accurately identify various actions.

articleTitle: Smart City Network Security Evaluation System
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: In order to overcome the current network security problems in the process of smart city construction and improve the accuracy of smart city network security evaluation, this paper proposes a novel smart city network security evaluation system. The evaluation system comprehensively and systematically analyzes the current network security threats faced by smart city, and according to the design principles of smart city network security indicators, constructs a new smart city network security evaluation index system. The results show that the evaluation system can provide a good network environment for citizens.

articleTitle: Coal Gangue Detection Method Based on Improved SSD Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: In order to solve the problems of high time complexity and window redundancy in the traditional target detection algorithm based on artificial features, this paper proposes an end-to-end single-stage coal gangue detection algorithm based on deep learning. In view of the complex network structure and huge network parameters of SSD model, SSD-MobileNet network, which is combined with SSD and MobileNet network, is adopted in this paper to realize the detection of coal gangue. The MobileNet model is a lightweight model designed specifically for embedded mobile devices with both low latency and high precision. The experimental results show that the average detection accuracy of SSD-MobileNet algorithm reaches 91.5%, and the detection time of a single image is 0.04s.

articleTitle: Radio frequency fingerprint recognition based on deep learning
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: In order to overcome the problems of low accuracy and environmental impact of radio frequency fingerprint identification method, this paper proposes a radio frequency fingerprint identification method based on improved resnet50. This method adds random noise to IQ signal to increase network robustness, and then obtains IQ with different sampling rate through hole convolution, and gives different weights to different feature vectors by using attention mechanism Finally, features are extracted and classified by resnet50 backbone. Experimental results show that the improved network achieves 91.70% recognition accuracy in RF fingerprint task.

articleTitle: Rolling Element Bearing Fault Diagnosis Based on EEMD and Index of Envelope Spectrum Sparse Ratio
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: In order to overcome the problems of low accuracy in rolling element bearing fault identification, a new index named envelope spectrum sparse ration (ESSR) based on the sparse representation of envelope spectrum is proposed. This method used to realize quantitative envelope spectrum analysis by calculating the ratio of the fault frequency amplitude to the mean value of other frequency amplitudes. Moreover, the ESSR is also employed to select the most informative intrinsic mode function (IMF) derived from the EEMD of fault vibration signal. Finally, both the simulation and the experiment data demonstrate the validation of the ESSR, which could help to find the optimal IMF in the rolling element bearing fault diagnosis.

articleTitle: Research of energy saving control System of Mine belt conveyors
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: In order to overcome the problems of low efficiency and high energy consumption of traditional belt conveyor control system, a new energy saving control method of belt conveyor based on fuzzy algorithm is proposed. This method analyzes the composition and structure of the control system for belt conveyor, selects frequency control method to reducing energy consumption, at the same time, matches belt conveyor speed and transportation capacity. On the basis of the above, through the formula of speed of induction motor, combined with fuzzy algorithm, energy saving control System of mine belt conveyors is completed. The simulation results show that the proposed method can effectively match speed and transportation capacity of the belt conveyor and reduce speed of the belt conveyor and energy consumption. The maximum economize energy is thirty percent. The practical application shows that this method has a certain effect of energy saving.

articleTitle: English Speech Recognition Method Based on HMM Technology
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: In order to solve the problem of insufficient feedback and intelligent speech recognition in English pronunciation learning, this paper designs and implements an English speech learning system based on speech recognition technology. Matlab is used to complete the sample speech data collection and preprocessing. Combined with the needs of Chinese speaking English learners, the speech recognition technology based on HMM model is used to decode the speech by Viterbi, and the recognition score is obtained by posterior probability. The experimental results show that this scheme greatly reduces the search space and effectively shortens the algorithm time without affecting the recognition accuracy. The function of each module of the system has been well implemented. The system can be used by users normally and is stable in function and performance.

articleTitle: FPGA Implementation of AES Encryption Optimization Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: To improve the confidentiality of data transmission and the efficiency of encryption and decryption, this paper uses FPGA to improve the traditional AES encryption algorithm. The scheme uses pipeline technology to optimize the structure of AES algorithm, including the key expansion part and the encryption and decryption part. Then, the AES encryption algorithm in 128bit initial key mode is implemented, and the bit width conversion module is written, so that the encryption part can be connected with other types of bus. The experimental analysis uses Quartus tool to compile AES algorithm, and establish entity PCB circuit to test in real environment. The experimental results show that the optimization algorithm can complete the encryption and decryption function, and improve the data throughput and clock frequency.

articleTitle: Short-Term Road Traffic Flow Prediction Based on Multi-Dimensional Data
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: In order to overcome the dynamic interference problem of internal related factors in the prediction process of road traffic flow, a deep learning road traffic flow prediction model based on multi-dimensional influence factors is proposed. On the basis of analyzing the characteristics of traffic flow time and space, this model analyzes the traffic flow characteristics of urban traffic system under the relevant factors such as working day, holidays and weather, quantifies the relevant influence factors, and constructs multi-dimensional state vectors combined with road traffic flow. Simulations show that MAE of the MDLSTM prediction model based on multi-dimensional data is reduced by 5.528 and 3.018, and RMSE is reduced by 6.827 and 2.154, respectively, compared with the traditional BP neural network and LSTM models.

articleTitle: Research on the optimization of rural e-commerce human resources based on big data
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: In order to improve the accuracy and rationality of rural e-commerce human resource data mining, this paper puts forward the research of rural e-commerce human resource optimization based on big data. This paper analyzes the demand structure of rural e-commerce human resources, and mines the relevant data of human resources personnel of a rural e-commerce enterprise in Heilongjiang Province. Based on the principle of e-commerce information, human resource gain is calculated. This paper analyzes the constraints of rural e-commerce human resource allocation, constructs the objective function of rural e-commerce human resource allocation, and completes the rural e-commerce human resource allocation. The experimental results show that the proposed human resource allocation method has high data mining accuracy and optimization rationality, and can meet the needs of rural e-commerce human resource allocation.

articleTitle: Aircraft segmentation algorithm based on Unet and improved Yolov4
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: In order to overcome the problems of poor effect and low accuracy of semantic segmentation of aircraft target, a small target segmentation method based on improved Yolov4 and Unet is proposed. This method combines Yolov4, Unet and Mobilenet. In order to reduce the parameters of the model, Mobilenet is used to improve the Yolov4 backbone network. The improved Yolov4 is used to extract the ROI in the image, then the image is sent to VGG16-Unet for segmentation, finally, the segmented sub objects are fused with the original image to obtain a complete segmentation image. The RSOD-Dataset is used as the training dataset, and UCAS-AOD dataset is used to verify the generalization ability of the model. The experimental results show that the model has a good segmentation effect on the aircraft target in the image.

articleTitle: Research on Intelligent Education Method Based on Data Mining of Distance Education System
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: To solve the problem of single system education mode in network distance education, an intelligent service model of distance education based on Web mining is proposed. This paper first provides the general process of data processing in distance education system, including data preparation and selection, data preprocessing, mining algorithm selection and implementation. Then, through the improvement of Apriori algorithm, we extract part of the experimental data to construct the mining model. Through the application analysis of the model, we acquire the rule set to provide personalized guidance for students. According to the mining results, the system can dynamically generate a set of pages that users may be interested. The practice has proved that the application of Web Mining Technology in the distance learning system improves the personalized service level of the learning system, and provides an intelligent auxiliary means for the decision analysis.

articleTitle: Path tracking and navigation system of unmanned vehicle based on linear CCD
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: In order to improve the application effect of the path tracking and navigation system for unmanned vehicles, a new path tracking and navigation system for unmanned vehicles based on linear CCD is designed in this paper. The hardware of the system is composed of information acquisition module, multi-source information integration module, vehicle path tracking module and vehicle navigation module. In the hardware design of the system software on the basis of the design, calculation of driverless cars and driving direction angle of the vehicle path width, on the basis of general timer as multi-source sensor signal capture time base, is the center of the line array CDD chip count, by using the results of real-time adjustment, driverless cars driving deviation run path following unmanned vehicle navigation. The experimental results show that the path tracking results of the system are more accurate, the path planning time is shorter and the user satisfaction is higher.

articleTitle: Innovative Method of Urban Planning Based on Intelligent City
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: In order to overcome the problems of urban planning in the context of smart city, this paper proposes an innovative method of urban planning based on intelligent city. The innovative multi-dimensional approache realizes the innovation and development of urban planning from multiple dimensions, which are idea innovation, basis innovation, method innovation and practice innovation. Based on this, the innovation path also combines a variety of advanced science and technology, such as artificial intelligence technology, big data technology, cloud computing technology, etc. The results show that the innovation path can transform the challenges faced by urban planning into opportunities, and realize the sustainable development of the city.

articleTitle: An Internet of Things Intrusion Detection Method Based on CNN-FDC
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: In order to overcome the problem of weak function and low accuracy when the traditional intrusion detection system is faced with complex and high-dimensional network data characteristics. This paper proposes a CNN-FDC (CNN + focus loss + Dropout-Connect) detection method based on convolutional neural networks. After converting the KDD-CUP99 data set to grayscale images, the Dropout-Connect method is used to enhance the model’s ability to eliminate overfitting, and then Focal Loss is used as a loss function to solve the problem of sample imbalance in the data set. From what have been discussed above, it can be concluded that, compared with the traditional LeNet-5 and KNN machine learning algorithms, the model adding the confusion matrix judgment performs better and relatively high accuracy rate.

articleTitle: Research on Intelligent Management and Control Technology of Power Grid Engineering Based on BIM
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: In view of the development trend of power grid engineering cluster and the shortcomings of current engineering construction management, this paper proposes an intelligent management and control system for power grid engineering by integrating BIM with RFID and network technology. The whole scheme adopts information technology to plan the rolling progress of safety prevention and control from the perspective of organization, workflow and management. In the main function module design, the key technologies of remote monitoring, function management and label definition are discussed. Then the prototype of intelligent management and control system for power grid engineering based on BIM and RFID is developed with C#. Finally, according to the specific project case, the function test of the system is performed, which proves that it can realize the dynamic monitoring and management of points, lines and surfaces, effectively improve the management efficiency of power grid engineering, and reduce the possibility of safety accidents.

articleTitle: Research and Development of Building Construction Safety Management System Based on BIM Technology
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: In order to overcome the problems existing in construction safety management, this paper puts forward a novel research and development scheme of construction safety management system based on BIM technology. The research and development program combines BIM technology, giving full play to the advantages of BIM technology. Based on this, the research and development scheme improves the safety management level of construction from the three dimensions of safety, progress and quality. The results show that the research and development program can indeed improve the safety management level of construction and promote the vigorous development of the construction industry.

articleTitle: Analysis and Optimization Strategy of Travel Hotel Website Reservation Behavior Based on Collaborative Filtering
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: To improve the effect of hotel personalized recommendation, this paper proposes a specific scheme using collaborative filtering algorithm applied to tourism website. According to the user’s recent hotel reservation behavior, the system clusters and infers the user’s interest, and makes relevant statistics combined with the characteristics of hotel search. Then, the detail recommendation technology based on collaborative filtering algorithm is discussed, and the nearest neighbor set which can express user preferences is selected for similarity calculation. Finally, on the basis of the overall architecture design of the recommendation system, the merging algorithm used in the system is explained and tested on classic data sets. The experimental results show that the similarity algorithm using collaborative filtering and the accuracy of behavior analysis are greatly improved compared with the traditional algorithms, which also makes the recommendation results more in line with the user’s intention, and has less resource consumption.

articleTitle: Research on polar Decoding Method Based on Convolutional Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: In order to overcome the problems of high bit error rate, delay and complexity, research on CNN polar decoding algorithm is proposed. This method uses CNN as the decoder, analyzes the difference between the traditional algorithm and the CNN decoder, adjusts the network parameters, obtains the best parameters, makes the decoder optimal, and in the channel coding scheme, the encoding and decoding complexity of polarized codes is low, and it has been strictly proved that they can reach the Shannon limit. However, there are a lot of shortcomings in the existing traditional decoding algorithms, With the maturity of deep learning, the application of deep learning to the field of communication, deep learning has advantage of powerful computing, and neural network after training is static, once only need data through the network, so the deep learning was applied to the polarization code decoding process, can effectively reduce the decoding delay and improve the efficiency of decoding, this paper mainly studies convolution decoder of neural networks in all aspects of performance, can get the conclusion by experiment, with the increase of the number of iterations network decoding ability improved, error performance is getting better and better, and CNN has obvious advantages.

articleTitle: A Method For Comprehensive Ability Assessment of Smart City Construction From The Perspective of Big Data
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: In order to overcome the problems of incomprehensive and objective evaluation of the comprehensive ability of smart city construction under the background of big data, a method of coupling coordination degree model of the comprehensive ability of smart city construction based on entropy method and coupling coordination theory was proposed. This method constructs the coupling coordination degree model of the comprehensive ability of smart city construction from three aspects of smart government, smart transportation and smart education and nine indicators. The results show that this method can effectively evaluate the comprehensive ability of smart city construction, and the results are more comprehensive and objective. The maximum coupling degree is 1.

articleTitle: Prediction of distributed optical fiber monitoring data based on GRU-BP
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: In order to solve the problem that it is difficult to monitor the frequency shift value of the undistributed optical fiber monitoring points in the coal mining distributed optical fiber monitoring, the paper is based on the physical simulation experiment of the distributed optical fiber two-dimensional simulation mining overburden deformation, using the excavation distance and optical fiber monitoring Point height, elastic modulus, tensile strength, compressive strength and other experimental data construct the characteristic attributes of model samples, and propose a distributed optical fiber monitoring frequency shift value prediction algorithm based on GRU-BP. This method is used to predict the frequency shift of unknown monitoring points. It has high accuracy in terms of value, which provides an idea for predicting the frequency shift value at the monitoring point of the unburied fiber. At the same time, the traditional neural network model is established on the premise that the training sample and the test sample are unchanged, and the prediction results of the GRU-BP combined model are compared and analyzed. The experimental results show that: using the GRU-BP algorithm, the prediction effects of R2, MAE, and RMSE can reach 0.91, 0.45, and 0.73, respectively, and their effects are better than traditional neural network models.

articleTitle: Design of Intelligent Health-Care System based on STM32
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: In order to solve the contradiction between the pressure of young people’s life and the health care of the elderly, and how to make the young people work well and take care of the elderly at the same time, this paper designs an intelligent health care system, which uses the Internet of Things and embedded technology to record and monitor the blood pressure, weight, heart rate, etc. of the elderly at home. This intelligent health care system takes the main approach of STM32 with a modular structure and finally displays the situation of the elderly at home through a GUI interface. The test results show that the system allows young people to monitor their parents’ physical condition and deal with it in time, which can effectively improve the happiness index of the elderly at home.

articleTitle: Prediction Method of Optical Cable Line Fault Probability Based on Improved KNN Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: In order to overcome the problem that it is difficult to predict the damage and interruption of optical cable line in advance to take targeted maintenance, this paper proposes a fault probability prediction method based on the type of optical cable laying and the state of the surrounding environment of the cable line, so as to predict the fault probability of optical cable line. By learning the historical data of optical cable line fault and using KNN (K Nearest Neighbor) algorithm for reference, the probability of fault in different segments of optical cable line can be effectively estimated to enhance the pertinency of operation and maintenance. The test of the method shows that the maintenance based on the probability prediction method proposed in this paper can effectively reduce the occurrence of cable fault.

articleTitle: Research on Network Topology Analysis Method of Distribution Management Based on GIS
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: In order to share resources between the system and other information management systems of the distribution network, and make full use of the existing data of the distribution network, this paper discusses the object-oriented modeling method of the distribution network data model and the design of the spatial data model of the distribution network, and adopts the breadth first search method based on the platform for topology analysis. Then, the modeling method of distribution network topology analysis is studied. The hybrid management method is used to manage equipment nodes and database resources, and the association between topology data and physical model is established through XML document. In the case study, taking a park network as an example, it is proved that the proposed data model and spatial topology analysis algorithm of distribution network have the characteristics of high efficiency and easy implementation through the development of advanced functions of distribution network management system.

articleTitle: Research on Swarm Intelligence Optimization of E-commerce Supply Chain Resources
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: To effectively improve the logistics distribution process in e-commerce supply chain, this paper proposes an intelligent scheduling strategy based on ant colony optimization algorithm to realize the dynamic allocation in supply chain management. Aiming at the shortcomings of poor convergence and easy stagnation of ant colony algorithm, we use GA to improve ant colony algorithm. The pheromone diffusion strategy and the improved pheromone global update mechanism are introduced, and the corresponding scheme of the improved algorithm in the logistics distribution path optimization problem is described in detail. Finally, the key functions and processes of the system are tested through an e-commerce case. The results show that the proposed scheme has high computational performance and convergence time, which can deliver more orders on time, and improves the efficiency of e-commerce supply allocation business.

articleTitle: Channel Capacity Analysis of UWB-MIMO System
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: In the communication system, how to improve the system channel capacity has been a key research direction. MIMO (multiple-input multiple-output) technology can greatly improve the channel capacity. The combination of MIMO technology and UWB (Ultra-wideband) wireless communication technology forms a UWB-MIMO system. In this paper, the UWB system, MIMO system, and UWB-MIMO system are mainly taken as the research objects , and whether the channel capacity of UWB-MIMO system is improved compared with MIMO and UWB wireless communication technology is studied. The channel capacity of the three technologies is obtained by formula calculation, and the corresponding results are obtained by comparison.

articleTitle: Application of Content Based Recommendation System in Homestay
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: In order to overcome the problems of the application of recommender system in homestay industry is not perfect and can not provide personalized choice for users, a recommendation system for homestay is proposed. The system is based on content recommendation. First of all, from a large number of users’ comments on homestay, we use Jieba and stop word list to make a Chinese word segmentation corpus. Then we use word2vec training corpus to get homestay label features. Then the TF-IDF model is used to vectorize the tag features, and the similarity value of the feature vector is calculated by cosine similarity to get the push value of the new user, and the user preference table is constructed by selecting tags. When the user completes the subscription, the user preferences table is updated to complete the recommendation. The system designed in this paper show that the accuracy and real-time of recommendation, improves user satisfaction, and provides personalized recommendation for users.

articleTitle: Research on Radio Propagation Model Based on VHF Band
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: The modes of electromagnetic wave propagation include direct radiation, reflection, diffraction and scattering. Different environments produce different modes of transmission. Most cellular wireless systems operate in urban areas, including no direct line-of-sight (LOS) paths between transmitters and receivers, and severe diffraction losses due to high-rise buildings. In addition, due to the multipath reflection of different objects, electromagnetic waves passing through different length paths interact to cause multipath fading. At the same time, with the increasing distance between the transmitter and receiver, the electromagnetic wave intensity is attenuated. The study of propagation model focuses on the prediction of the average received signal field intensity at a certain distance from the transmitter on the one hand, and on the variation of the signal field intensity near a specific location on the other hand. In order to obtain the most suitable radio transmission model for the Northwest region, in this paper, with 833 MHZ as the transmitted power in lanzhou region, were tested, and then use Okumura - Hata model and radio propagation model of Lee model, using MSE, RMSE, MAE characterization of its performance, results show that Okumura - Hata model and Lee both fit the radio propagation model from lanzhou region, and Lee model relative to Okumura Hata model better.

articleTitle: Modulation Recognition Algorithm Based on ResNet50 Multi-feature Fusion
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: In order to solve the problem of low accuracy of modulation pattern recognition under the condition of low signal-to-noise ratio in traditional modulation pattern recognition methods, this paper proposes a modulation recognition algorithm based on ResNet50 multi-feature fusion. This method uses the ResNet50 network that introduces an attention mechanism, and on this basis, through the extraction of three data characteristics of IQ signal, signal spectrogram and constellation diagram, and the multi-feature fusion of the three characteristic data as the input of the network. By comparing the improved ResNet5 and ResNet50, VGG-19, VGG-16 under the conditions of -10dB, -5dB, 0dB, 5dB, and 10dB in different signal-to-noise ratios. The experimental result shows that the improved method can effectively identify 7 types of digital signal modulation modes, namely 2FSK, 4FSK, BPSK, QPSK, 8PSK, 16QAM, and 64QAM under the condition of low signal-to-noise ratio. Especially when the signal-to-noise ratio is -5dB, the average recognition rate of the ReSNet50 network based on multi-feature fusion can reach 93.41%.

articleTitle: The Fusion Of GPS And Gyroscope Based On Kalman Filter
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: In order to overcome the problems that the gyroscope will produce cumulative errors during long-term operation and the magnetometer is extremely susceptible to interference from the external environment. A new method of Kalman fusion model combining gyroscope and GPS is proposed in this paper. This method uses angle information which is read by GPS as the observation value, and heading angle which is obtained through the angular velocity integral model as the prior estimation value, performing Kalman fusion between them for obtaining the posterior estimate. The experimental results show that the proposed method can dynamically adjust the heading angle calculated by the integrator so that the accuracy of the estimated heading angle is improved. The dynamic response capability of the proposed model is excellent. The MSE of the average heading angle which is obtained by reading GPS in a period of time and the heading angle which is fused with GPS and gyroscope in different time periods is 6.87.

articleTitle: Intelligent Control System Design for High Vacuum Die Casting Process
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: Aiming at the problems of low operation reliability and maintainability of the original vacuum die-casting workers, various complex parameters control and monitoring requirements, this paper proposes a control method for vacuum pressure regulating casting control system based on PLC. We make a detailed description of the design idea of the control system and the design and implementation of the specific software and hardware. During the control process, the absolute pressure sensor of acquisition layer is used to acquire the pressure value of differential pressure casting equipment, and the pressure data is transmitted to the main control layer through CAN bus. In equipment operation, fuzzy self-tuning PID algorithm is adopted to control the production process. The experimental results show that the intelligent control system of vacuum die casting has high control precision and sensitive response, which shortens the time of intelligent control and exception handling in vacuum casting production.

articleTitle: Review and Case Study of The Impact of VR Technology on Internet 3D Game Design
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: Game users have higher and higher requirements for VR application experience, which makes it an urgent problem for developers to improve the quality of VR application and user experience. Therefore, this paper analyzes the main impact of the current VR technology on Internet games, as well as the main development technology. Then the Virtools technology sets Unity3d engine as a development tool to complete the development of 3D games. Finally, with the help of unity3d engine and 3dsmax modeling software, the whole system development process is realized by using modular design idea. Data aggregation statistics and algorithm analysis are performed to generate monitoring report in the form of visual chart and the test results show that the system runs well. It not only has practical application value, but also has theoretical significance. It can be also extended to other fields such as distributed computing, distributed cooperative work and online game development.

articleTitle: Reactive Power and Voltage Coordinate Optimization of Distribution Network Under the New Energy Environment Based on CCP
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: In order to reduce the operational risk brought by the distributed power supply access to the distribution network, this paper establishes a reactive voltage opportunity constrained programming model with an objective function of network loss and voltage deviation of the distribution network in the new energy environment, and solves and analyzes the model with the MODE algorithm to verify the validity and correctness of the model and algorithm. After optimization, the voltage deviation and network loss of the system are reduced.

articleTitle: An Improved YOLO Leucocyte Classification and Recognition Method
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: In order to solve the problem of leukocyte category recognition under complex background, YOLOv3 model is improved in this paper.First, use the K-means algorithm to cluster the anchor boxes to obtain three different sizes of anchor boxes for potential targets to be identified. Then, the squeeze excitation network are introduced into the basic network of the YOLOv3 network to improve the matching Target recognition accuracy and scale utilization degree. The experimental results show that in the 11 types of leukocyte classification tasks, the average average accuracy of the improved YOLO network is 0.937. Compared with the original YOLO network, the improved method has better performance in leukocyte classification and recognition.

articleTitle: Development and Implementation of Border Tourism Resources Evaluation System Based on GIS
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: Traditional evaluation methods cannot highlight the characteristics of border tourism resources, which is not conducive to highlight the characteristics of border tourism, so this paper introduces the related theories of tourism resources evaluation, establishes a tourism resources investigation and evaluation system based on GIS, and analyzes the structure and spatial distribution characteristics of tourism resources with the help of GIS technology. In the evaluation method, the quantitative mathematical evaluation model is used, and the satellite image network map is used to plot, which realizes the functions of tourism resource collection and tourism resource attribute information input. The system test results show that the scheme can provide the partition statistics of excellent tourism resources, realize the visualization of the collected data, such as numbers, words, charts and images, and play an auxiliary decision-making function for the scientific management and utilization of tourism resources data.

articleTitle: Research on Passenger Flow Forecast of Urban Rail Transit Based on SARIMA-RBF Combination Model
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: Passenger flow forecast is the basis of passenger transportation organization, and the forecast results can provide decision basis for operation management and emergency response. The actual passenger flow variation has both linear and nonlinear patterns. According to the characteristics of Seasonal Autoregressive Integrated Moving Average model and Radial Basis Function neural network model, the combined model established in this paper by combining these two models can grasp the linear law of passenger flow sequence, effectively solve the linear change law of passenger flow sequence, and also take into account the nonlinear law sequence of passenger flow.

articleTitle: The Construction Cost Management Method Based on BIM Information Integration Platform
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: The current research on construction project construction management has a poor internal control over the construction information, and the processing performance of the auxiliary aspect of building construction is low, which cannot achieve the precise cost management operation of construction engineering construction, which leads to the poor final cost management effect. Based on the BIM information integration platform, a new method of construction cost management is studied. The basic information of construction engineering is analyzed, and the specific contents of data, dynamic entity engineering and entity cost modeling analysis management are analyzed. The overall construction process is controlled according to the analysis data. Finally, the management model is set up, the relevant engineering information of construction engineering is adjusted, and the management mechanism is recorded to complete the study of overall construction cost management. The experimental results show that the construction cost management method based on BIM information integration platform can improve the accuracy of construction management to a certain extent, and is conducive to the development of management research and has good research results.

articleTitle: Transponder Signal Detection Simulation Based on Variable Scale Stochastic Resonance Theory
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: In order to achieve high-precision detection of transponder uplink signals submerged in a noisy environment, a method for detecting transponder uplink signals based on stochastic resonance theory is proposed in this paper. The method takes advantage of the fact that the signal, nonlinear system and noise can be optimally matched to convert the noise energy into signal energy, thus improving the signal-to-noise ratio. In order to make the balise uplink signal meet the requirements of the stochastic resonance theory, the characteristics of the balise uplink signal are first analyzed. Then, the balise uplink signal is normalized and scaled according to the requirements of the stochastic resonance theory. Finally, MATLAB software is used to select appropriate parameters to simulate the system. The simulation results show that the uplink of the transponder can meet the signal detection requirements of the stochastic resonance system with high detection accuracy after normalization and scaling processing.

articleTitle: Road crack detection algorithm based on YOLOv3
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: In order to overcome the problems that may cause pedestrians, driving safety and other major economic losses, road cracks must be discovered in time and resolved as soon as possible. The paper proposes the detection of road cracks based on the YOLOv3 algorithm. In order to further improve the accuracy, this method is optimized on the basis of the traditional YOLOv3 algorithm, and uses MSE, GIOU_Loss and CIOU_Loss as the bounding box regression loss function into YOLOv3 to detect road cracks. Experimental results show that the improved detection accuracy of YOLOv3 algorithm using MSE, GIOU_Loss and CIOU_Loss loss functions are 84.98%, 88.73% and 92.97%, respectively. It can be seen that the YOLOv3 algorithm using the CIOU_Loss loss function can identify cracks more quickly and accurately while maintaining real-time performance. This method provides a simpler, more intuitive and effective way for road health. It has certain value in real life applications.

articleTitle: Identification and Positioning of Engineering Vehicle in UAV Inspection for Optical Cable Lines
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: In order to overcome the low efficiency and high risk of the traditional manual inspection method of optical cable lines, this paper proposes a method of identification and positioning of engineering vehicle in UAV inspection. The method is based on the Pytroch deep learning framework and uses YOLOv4 target detection algorithm to realize intelligent detection of hidden faults. At the same time, the paper designs the positioning algorithm of the UAV inspection target based on the image coordinates of the recognition target and the multiple coordinate conversion method. Through test experiments, the results show that the AP value of engineering vehicles inspected by UAV reaches 83.28%, and the target positioning accuracy is about 20 meters, which can meet the inspection requirements. The test results show that based on the method proposed in the paper, the hidden faults of the optical cable can be accurately identified and located, which can effectively improve the inspection efficiency and reduce the workload of the inspectors.

articleTitle: Intelligent Evaluation of College Students’ Ideological and Political Education Effect Based on Big Data Technology
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: In the current ideological and political teaching evaluation, due to many comprehensive evaluation standards, complex process, resource consumption and other reasons, the evaluation is insufficient or mere formality. Thus, this paper proposes a classroom evaluation assistant strategy based on big data technology. The scheme mainly uses a new multi class classification algorithm which takes the similarity direction between classes as the IBTSVM generation algorithm, reads the data from the web system, and trains it by SVM train. Through the method of cross validation, the parameter setting of SVM is obtained. Finally, the algorithm is applied to the evaluation of teachers’ teaching quality, and the samples are trained and verified by case analysis, which proves that the application of intelligent teaching evaluation method based on big data in teaching evaluation classification is feasible and effective.

articleTitle: Design and Research of Virtual Reality Teaching Assistant System for Colleges and Universities Experimental Course Under the Background of Wisdom Education
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: In order to overcome the problems of single teaching mode, lack of physical space, high cost of equipment and low initiative of students in traditional laboratory education in colleges and universities, a virtual reality teaching assistant system based on virtual reality technology (VR) is designed. The design of the system is mainly divided into the design of the preliminary plan of the system, the design of the system functions as well as the design of the system application scenarios. Among these, the functions of the system mainly include the display function of VR experiment effect, the simulation function of VR experiment, and the evaluation function of VR experiment knowledge. Students interact with the virtual scene through VR helmet and VR handle to understand the purpose and effect of the experiment, participate in the operation of the experiment, master the experimental process and acquire experimental knowledge. In the system test, taking the computer host assembly experiment as a case, the experimental result indicated that the application of the system in the experimental teaching process of colleges and universities is conducive to improving students’ learning initiative and knowledge absorption efficiency.

articleTitle: Demodulation of Low SNR QPSK Signal Based on CNN
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: In order to overcome the problems of high bit error rate of QPSK demodulation under low signal-to-noise ratio in traditional modulation pattern recognition methods, a new QPSK demodulation method under the condition of low signal-to-noise ratio based on convolutional neural network is proposed. This method inputs the IQ signal into the denoise network, and then the convolution neural network is used for demodulation. The loss function is the cross entropy of the demodulated symbol sequence and the original symbol sequence multiplied by the transmitter RF signal and the denoise of the receiver. On the basis of the above, through this method, the bit error rate of QPSK demodulation when the signal-to-noise ratio is in a relatively low state can be effectively reduced. Simulation results show that this method can effectively reduce the bit error rate under the condition of low signal-to-noise ratio. When the SNR is -20dB, the average bit error rate is 6.98%, which is 38.85% lower than traditional coherent demodulation.

articleTitle: Automatic Detection Approach of Basketball Track in Sports Video
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: Video image track of basketball flight path can precisely analyze flight trajectory curve in basketball so as to direct basketball shooting training. Thus, this paper puts forward image video sequence analysis and adaptive objective model-based flight trajectory tracking method of basketball. This algorithm fully utilizes correlation of time and space between adjacent blocks. On one hand, in order to overcome effect of basketball rotary motion, matching criterion which is not related to regional location is set up; on the other hand, diamond movement search path is improved based on sport correlation of basketball and center-biased characteristics in order to reduce search times and improve tracking speed. The experiment results show that methods in this paper can effectively track basketball under complex background and have effective robustness of basketball rotary movement and partial occlusion.

articleTitle: Physiological Data Collection and Early Warning System for Elderly Living Alone Based on Internet of Things Technology
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: This paper provides a solution of physiological data collection and early warning system for the elderly living alone based on Internet of Things technology. The system adopts STC15F2K60S2 chip microcomputer, various sensors, display screen, buzzer and other hardware for system development. The system realizes the real-time collection and display of human physiological data such as blood pressure, heart rate, step counting, body temperature, indoor temperature and humidity information. When the data of blood pressure, heart rate and temperature exceeded the preset value, the server would warn with flashing lights and buzzers. The system experimented the functions of information acquisition, display and early warning of mobile phone and PC. In addition, the server can synthesize data collected over a period of time to predict the value of future data. The system can be used for the nursing of the elderly living alone or the monitoring and management of the special population in the community by community workers, effectively preventing the physiological accidents and psychological hidden dangers of the elderly and those with mobility difficulties.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Sports Health Teaching Live Broadcast System for Mobile Platform
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: In order to improve the teaching effect of sports health course and provide full play to the social effect of high-quality teaching resources in colleges, this paper designs an online sports course live broadcast platform based on mobile terminal in the Android Studio integrated environment. Aiming at the multi module requirements of webcast, the paper takes the development form of Model-View-Presenter as the infrastructure, and provides the technical realization of key modules and main functions from the overall structure of the platform, video transmission protocol, information communication module and live broadcast coding. At the same time, the database and client UI of the interactive teaching live system are designed to meet the real-time access needs of users. The test and analysis of the system in the real environment show that the live platform of this paper realizes the information application of mobile learning in sports health teaching, and it has good stability and security.

articleTitle: Research on the Innovation System of Image Art Based on Digital Media
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: In order to overcome the limitations and inherent mode of traditional image art, this paper proposes an innovative system of image art based on digital media. Combined with the characteristics of digital media, the innovation system innovates the image art from three dimensions, namely, technological innovation, artistic innovation and concept innovation. Based on this, the innovation system combines a variety of science and technology, such as big data technology and virtual reality technology, and strengthens the deep integration and innovation development level of digital media and image art. The research results show that the innovation system can break through the limitations of traditional image art and realize the organic combination of image art with the current social development level and public aesthetic concept.

articleTitle: Research on Intelligent PID Control Algorithm Based on Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: It is difficult to set PID parameters in PID control, so that the control accuracy, stability and reliability of the control system cannot be guaranteed. In this paper, the parameter tuning method of PID controller based on BP neural network is analyzed. By establishing a three-layer neural network model, a PID controller with self-learning parameters is constructed. Then, genetic algorithm is used to optimize the parameters of PID control system, and the specific application steps are given. The analysis of simulation results shows that the PID controller designed in this paper performs well in following performance, anti-interference and robustness. Moreover, through this iteration, the number of learning cycles can be increased, and the iterative process will converge quickly.

articleTitle: Research on English Cloud Classroom Blended Teaching Mode Based on Mobile APP
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: To promote English learning with the development of blended learning and mobile learning, this paper designs and develops a blended English learning platform based on mobile APP. This paper also designs a mobile learning platform under Android environment. The background management system adopts the latest SSM framework of Java EE, which effectively solves the problem of server-side development. Client users login using OAuth authentication, and XML data using Sax parsing. At the same time, it can realize the safe storage of data and client fast access. The classroom communication module of such system is embedded with Baidu's cloud push technology to realize the search engine. The final system test analysis shows that the mobile learning system has friendly interface, convenient operation, reliable and stable performance.

articleTitle: Analytic Hierarchy Process and Intelligent Evaluation of Regional Sports Economic Data
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: To provide an accurate evaluation model or method for the specific output value and economic benefits of sports events, this paper attempts to establish a simple regional sports economic benefit data evaluation model to predict the best financing mode. We mainly use the methods of questionnaire survey, expert evaluation and SWOT to establish the quantitative model of regional sports economy in Yingxian County, and generate the corresponding level indicators. During such period, the industry proportion index is used to measure the level of sports industry agglomeration. Then, combined with the relevant data of a region from 2017 to 2020, this paper empirically analyzes the relationship between the development of sports industry and economic growth in the region, calculates the weight of each index and influencing factors by AHP method, and uses the index smoothing method to intelligently predict and evaluate the level of GDP. It is proved the conclusion can provide a certain policy reference for the decision-makers in the game of regional sports economy and the formulation of economic development strategy.

articleTitle: Novel Retinal Vessel Segmentation Method Based on U-net and FPN
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: To improve the accuracy of retinal image segmentation, a novel novel retinal vessel segmentation method based on U-net and FPN is proposed in this paper. This method uses skip-connection and convolutional layers of different sizes to generate residual blocks of different scales which obtain accurate acquisition of position information, then generates feature maps through feature fusion, and finally obtains semantic segmentation maps through a decoder layer. Many experiments have been performed on two public datasets. CHASE_DB1 and DRIVE have achieved subdivision accuracy of 97.20% and 96.48%, respectively. The performance results show that the automatic retinal vessel segmentation algorithm proposed in this paper is better than the latest in many verification indicators. The algorithm proposed by the algorithm can not only detect tiny blood vessels, but also capture large-scale high-level semantic ship features.

articleTitle: Oracle character detection based on improved Faster R-CNN
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: Oracle is the earliest known systematic writing in our country. It mostly originated from Shang Dynasty royal divination. The records cover a wide range of contents, including national politics, social atmosphere, and military wars. Oracle bone inscriptions are also the source of modem Chinese characters in my country, and they carry the history of Chinese civilization for thousands of years. At present, oracle bone characters still rely on manual identification and then handed over to experts to decipher, and the level of information is low. Therefore, in order to effectively detect oracle bones. In this paper, an improved object detection algorithm Faster R-CNN is proposed to detect oracle bone inscriptions. The algorithm uses ResNet101 as the backbone feature extraction network, and uses multi-scale feature fusion to improve text detection capabilities at different scales. Finally, the Soft-NMS algorithm is used to suppress redundant candidate regions. Experiments show that the average accuracy of the improved algorithm reaches 88.2%, which can effectively detect oracle bones.

articleTitle: Hotel Management Platform Design Based on Virtual Reality
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: The previous two-dimensional visual display mode cannot meet the needs of information acquisition in hotel management, so this paper introduces VR technology into the hotel industry and proposes a hotel management platform based on B/S mode. When building a 3D Hotel, it is combined with GIS technology. The administrator can complete the basic hotel design and management functions through 3D graphical user interface, realize the realistic display of complex network information, and set and present it to users through the secondary development function of VRGIS platform. At the same time, it introduces the implementation process of key technologies such as data preprocessing, scene fusion, Java structure and database connection, which provides hotel managers with an easy planning and entity operation interface. Finally, the running test results of the platform prove the feasibility and effectiveness of the scheme, which can support the management innovation practice of virtual reality in the hotel industry.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Smart College Psychological Service System for Community Based on C/S Architecture
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: To fully coordinate and integrate resources and provide psychological consultation services for college students and community residents, this paper analyzes the demand status of community public service platform, and puts forward a university community intelligent psychological service platform with university as the center and e-commerce mode. The solution is based on J2ME platform to develop client applications and C/S architecture. The development platform is Android+Eclipse and the database background management system uses mature SQLite, and adopts web services technology to realize the communication between client and server. For the key modules of the system, such as online psychological test, background management, data communication, the specific process and implementation method are provided. The system test results show that the platform effectively realizes the online interactive counseling service of many-to-many ways between colleges and communities, and improves the processing efficiency of psychological counseling business.

articleTitle: Development Strategy of Technology Finance Industry Based on Internet Thinking
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: In order to overcome the limitations and deficiencies in the development of technology finance industry, this paper puts forward a new development strategy of technology finance industry based on Internet thinking. The development strategy starts from the current situation and characteristics of China’s technology finance industry, aiming at the characteristics of technology finance and the advantages of science and technology. Based on this, the development strategy also provides new programs and new ideas for the development of technology finance industry. The results show that the development strategy can indeed reduce the risk of the technology finance industry, in line with the requirements of the current Internet era.

articleTitle: Implementation of English Online Course Teaching System Based on Virtual Reality Scene
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: At present, most of the developed virtual classrooms are difficult to create realistic teaching scenes. Therefore, this paper discusses the design objectives and ideas of the web-based virtual teaching system, and describes the basic architecture of the virtual teaching system. Firstly, the scene is designed and rendered by Unity3d, and the script code is written to access the recognition map database and its corresponding video. Then, using 3dsmax modeling and Virtools to realize the behavior interaction function, the experimental teaching courseware based on virtual scene is created. Finally, the overall functional structure of the virtual teaching system is studied, and the system including users and business processes are analyzed. The survey results show that the scene fidelity and interactivity basically achieve the expected goal, which has a good teaching effect in the process of practical teaching.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Auxiliary Application of Middle School Geography Textbook Based on Augmented Reality Technology
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: In order to overcome the problems of the poor three-dimensional display effect and weak interaction of traditional middle school geography textbook, an auxiliary application for middle school geography textbooks based on augmented reality technology (AR) was designed. Application according to the teaching content in the middle school geography textbook, based on augmented reality technology, the Unity3D game engine and 3D modeling software are used to combine 3D models, animations and videos with the pictures and text in the geography textbook to achieve the integration of virtual and reality. After downloading the application through mobile devices, students scan the illustrations in the textbooks, watch the displayed 3D models and animations, and interact with the displayed UI interfaces and models, so as to intuitively understand geographic knowledge, improve learning efficiency, and cultivate learning interest. The AR geography textbook auxiliary application also adds AR virtual button interaction and 360° panoramic interaction in the interactive design, which enriches the interactive functions of the AR geography textbook auxiliary application. Through investigation and research, the application of geography teaching in middle school is helpful to improve students’ learning enthusiasm. However, there are still problems with higher application design and development requirements and greater difficulty in teaching management, and further exploration and research are needed.

articleTitle: Design of transmission line safety early warning system based on big data variable analysis
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: In order to improve the accuracy and efficiency of transmission line safety early warning, a transmission line safety early warning system based on big data variable analysis is proposed. Firstly, the overall architecture of the system is designed under the B / S architecture. Secondly, in the hardware part of the system, the security data real-time monitoring module, data transmission module and security warning module are designed to meet the functional requirements of the system. Finally, in the system software design part, the big data variable analysis method is used to calculate the hidden danger of transmission line safety, so as to improve the effectiveness of transmission safety early warning. The experimental results show that, compared with the traditional security early warning system, the early warning accuracy and efficiency of the designed system are significantly improved, which can ensure the safe operation of the transmission line.

articleTitle: Risk Evaluation Model and Intelligent Assessment of Large Scale Sports Events
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: There are multiple deviations between the expected and actual risk of large-scale events, and it is not easy to be evaluated by quantitative model. Therefore, this paper uses the basic principles of AHP and BP neural network to establish the risk assessment model of the event. In the process, particle swarm optimization algorithm is used to optimize the weights of BP neural network and to improve the defects of BP neural network, such as slow convergence speed and easy to fall into local extremum. Then, through the establishment of membership matrix, the data of actual activities are acquired, and the neural network model is trained and tested by using Matlab mathematical software. The test results show that our scheme can effectively analyze the risk factors existing in each link of the event, and provide a scientific basis for making effective preventive measures and management decisions.

articleTitle: Computer Aided English Translation System Based on Artificial Intelligence Technology
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: In order to overcome the limitations of computer- aided English translation system, this paper proposes a novel computer-aided English translation system based on artificial intelligence technology. The system fully combines the advantages of artificial intelligence technology, can simulate human intelligence, according to the needs of users to carry out a series of work. Based on this, the system can also achieve innovation on the basis of the existing computer-aided translation system, and improve the quality of translation from terms management and quality management. The results show that the system can strengthen the combination of artificial intelligence technology and computer-aided translation system, and give full play to the advantages of artificial intelligence technology and computer-aided translation technology.

articleTitle: Innovation System of University Ideological and Political Education Mode Based on Big Data Technology
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: In order to overcome the challenges faced by the ideological and political education mode in colleges and universities in the era of big data, this paper proposes a new innovation system of Ideological and political education mode in colleges and universities based on big data technology. This innovation system is different from other innovation modes of ideological and political education, which gives full play to the characteristics of big data technology and combines ideological and political education with big data. The results show that the innovation system can not only promote the application and development of big data technology in the education industry, but also realize the further development of Ideological and political education mode.

articleTitle: Geochemical anomaly recognition based on Gaussian mixture model
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: In order to find the optimal method for identifying geochemical anomalies in geochemical exploration, the Gaussian mixture model and the deep autoencoder network were compared in this paper. Based on the determination of the optimal L value of the Gaussian mixture model and the structure of the deep autoencoder network, geochemical anomaly detection was carried out in the Yawan-Daqiao area, Gansu Province, China. The experimental results show that the geochemical data modeling results of the Gaussian mixture model and the deep autoencoder network are highly consistent with the mineralization characteristics of the study area, and the separated geochemical anomalies have a highly consistent spatial relationship with the known deposit positions in the study area.

articleTitle: Learning to Rank for Biomedical Information Retrieval
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: With the continuous development of biomedical, the scale of data has also continued to increase, which makes it difficult for researchers to extract information manually. In order to satisfy the researcher's information requirement, information retrieval techniques for the biomedical field have been resolved. Learning to rank is the field of machine learning and information retrieval combination, it has been shown to improve the retrieval efficiency to a large extent. This paper proposes a query optimization technology based on learning to rank. By using learning to rank for technical research on optimizing, a model combining query improvement and query expansion is proposed. Based on the improvement of the query, our method uses LTR to reorder the query expansion words, so that the original query can retrieve the document with higher accuracy. Only by biological field resources, the query expansion can obtain extended words, but it can not accurately describe the degree of relevance between extended words and query words. Introduce LTR methods can fully consider the relevance of extended words and original queries. Improve the inaccurate problem of single-extension. The experimental results show that compared with traditional algorithms, this algorithm improves retrieval efficiency by 3.31% on average.

articleTitle: Development and application of network platform for ideological and political education of college English course based on SSH
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: In order to overcome the problem that the existing online teaching platform of Ideological and Political Theory Course has poor application effect and cannot meet the needs of college English teaching, this paper proposes a design method of college English ideological and political teaching network platform based on SSH. Based on the SSH framework, this method establishes the ideological and political teaching framework of college English course on the network platform, and then sets up the operating mechanism of the teaching network platform, the design principles of teacher space design and the functional modules of teacher space, so as to realize the development of the network and the ideological and political teaching of college English course on the operating platform. The experimental results show that, compared with the existing platform, the application performance evaluation value of this development platform is generally larger, which fully proves that the application performance of this development platform is better.

articleTitle: Design and practice of an intelligent street lamp based on edge computing
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: In order to overcome the problems of turning on and off the street lamp regularly or manually, high energy consumption, and cumbersome fault maintenance and positioning, an intelligent street lamp using edge computing technology is designed: image processing technology is adopted at the terminal node to realize intelligent control of turning on and off the street lamp, and solar power is used to solve the problem of high energy consumption. The network technology Lora is used to the perception layer, and then upload the data to the server to facilitate query and statistics. In this system, edge computing is applied to the street lamp end, which solves the problem of energy consumption, and fault location is convenient and fast.

articleTitle: Research on Running Data Analysis Method Based on Attention-LSTM
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: Predicting injuries and illnesses through running data analysis methods can help improve athletic performance. However, running data has the characteristics of multi-dimensional and long time series. It is difficult to process running data using traditional analysis methods, and the prediction accuracy is low. In response to this problem, this paper proposes an analysis method based on the Attention-LSTM model for injury prediction. In this model, LSTM uses the timing-related characteristics of the data for deep learning, which improves the long-term dependence of the RNN model, and adds an Attention mechanism to eliminate data redundancy and improve prediction accuracy. Take the athlete running training data set as an example, use the first 80% of the data set to train the model, and use the last 20% of the data set to test. The Attention-LSTM model and the RNN, LSTM, BiLSTM and Attention-BiLSTM models were used for experimental comparison. The results show that the MSE, RMSE, and MAE values predicted by the Attention-LSTM model are lower than the RNN and LSTM models, the R_Squred value is greater than the RNN and LSTM models, and the Attention-LSTM model calculation time is less than the BiLSTM and Attention-BiLSTM models.
