Comprehensively measuring the prediction effect and time cost factors, the Attention-LSTM model can effectively eliminate data redundancy, reduce prediction errors and improve prediction accuracy. It is suitable as a method for running data analysis.

articleTitle: Foggy distance warning system based on LoRa technology
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: In order to overcome the problems of poor performance of distance detection based on deep learning, vehicle borne ultrasonic ranging system and vehicle borne radar automatic braking system in foggy and high-speed environment, this paper proposes a vehicle distance warning system based on the fusion of LoRa technology and laser ranging technology. The algorithm is established by visibility, speed, speed limit, distance and other factors, and the threshold value of minimum safe distance is set. Then the LoRa wireless network is used to monitor the distance between the front and rear vehicles. At the same time, the intelligent warning can be realized when the dangerous distance is between vehicles, so as to ensure the safety of high-speed driving in foggy days. The experimental results show that the system has the characteristics of wide protection range, low power consumption, high reliability and low cost.

articleTitle: Analysis of Complex Resilience Network Nodes Based on Resilience Contribution
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: In order to overcome the problem that it is difficult to quantitatively analyze the difference in the influence of network nodes on the resilience network, the paper proposes a quantitative analysis and evaluation method based on the elastic contribution degree to analyze the importance of complex resilience network nodes. From the perspective of information transmission, this method finds out the relationship between network structure and network information transmission capability, and reveals the corresponding relationship between network functions and structures. In addition, the method introduces information transmission capacity as an important indicator to measure changes in network performance, and provides a basis for changes in network performance. Simulation experiments show that this method can obtain the elastic changes of the network under different node repair rates, and can calculate the relationship between the control parameters of the elastic mode and the elastic contribution of the network nodes. The results show the effectiveness and feasibility of this method in calculating the difference of the influence of network nodes on the elastic network.

Index Terms: Importance Of Nodes In The Network

articleTitle: Feature extraction of online English learning behavior based on genetic algorithm
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: In order to solve the problem of low accuracy and efficiency of traditional online English learning behavior feature extraction methods, a method of online English learning behavior feature extraction based on genetic algorithm is proposed. This paper analyzes the generation mechanism of online English learning behavior data, and collects online English learning behavior data. Based on the collected data, K-means algorithm is used to cluster and mine online English learning behavior data. Based on the preprocessed data, the process of genetic algorithm is analyzed, and the feature extraction function of online English learning behavior is constructed to complete the feature extraction of online English learning behavior. Experimental results show that, compared with the traditional feature extraction method, the accuracy and efficiency of the proposed method are significantly improved.

articleTitle: Research and Construction of Scientific Research Project Sharing Platform Based on Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: In order to effectively avoid existed in the development of scientific research project, technical risk, market risk, financial risk, legal risk, organizing risk, and a series of wind, ensure the smooth progress of the research and development of scientific research project reduce project failure rate, improve the project achievement conversion rate, artificial intelligence technology has been widely used in the existing environment, artificial intelligence, neural network technology is introduced into the software development has become a possibility. In this paper, the idea of introducing BP neural network technology into the development process of sharing platform for scientific research projects is proposed. That the platform can be a lot of characteristic parameters of all kinds of scientific research project, utilizing the nonlinear mapping ability of BP neural network, adaptive ability and generalization ability of discrete data generation model, the implementation of a new project from multidimensional generate reliable outlook, to strengthen the scientific research project sharing platform project in the future the reliability of the prediction. It has been proved that the prediction of the prospect of scientific research projects based on BP neural network technology is more accurate and efficient than the prediction by the relevant personnel of scientific research projects, and the practical value of the sharing platform of scientific research projects is also improved.

articleTitle: Smart Classroom System Based on Internet of Things Wireless Communication Technology
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: With the continuous development of the Internet of Things technology, the "Internet of Everything" has gradually emerged from papers and laboratories, and has been widely used in education, medical and other fields. In order to overcome the difficulty of efficient centralized management and control of traditional classrooms, the paper mainly proposes a method of combining NB-IoT and Wi-Fi technology, relying on Alibaba Cloud and other IoT platforms to collect, process and analyze data, showing the trend of data changes. We use edge computing technology and face recognition technology to extract effective information in video data while ensuring customer privacy. Compared with traditional IoT solutions, this solution has lower cost and higher flexibility. Experimental results show that using Wi-Fi modules instead of NB-IoT modules can significantly reduce costs and reduce battery life pressure through sleep when necessary. Using DTU equipment as the gateway of the entire system can achieve flexible deployment and reduce the amount of construction.

articleTitle: A Novel Measurement Method for the Object Size and Shape Based on Image Recognition
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: In order to overcome the problem of non-contact, convenient and rapid measurement of the shape, size and distance of targets in the process of vehicle automatic driving, this paper proposes a non-contact measurement method based on image recognition and laser ranging. In this method, the shape and size of the object can be recognized after image segmentation, and the actual size of the object can be calculated by combining the distance data of laser feedback. The experimental tests show that the system has small object recognition and measurement errors, and can better determine obstacles on the road in the field of automatic driving.

articleTitle: Mobile crowd sensing : task assignment, privacy protection, incentive, and application
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: Mobile crowd sensing(MCS) system takes mobile intelligent devices (smart phones, tablets, etc.) carried by ordinary users as the basic perception unit. Through the mobile Internet (Wi-Fi, cellular network and wired network, etc.), conscious or unconscious collaboration is carried out to realize the distribution of sensing tasks and the collection and analysis of sensing data. Able to perform large-scale, complex perceptual tasks. The task completion of the mobile swarm intelligence sensing system depends on the participants or mobile intelligent devices, which leads to the need for the mobile swarm intelligence sensing system to meet certain constraints. In view of this, we described the task assignment model, privacy protection mechanism, incentive mechanism and other contents of the current mobile swarm intelligence perception system, and discussed the various applications of mobile swarm intelligence perception in life. Finally, the research direction of mobile swarm intelligence sensing system is proposed to improve the performance of mobile swarm intelligence sensing system in the future.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Neural Computing Platform Application System Based on Super Computing
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: In order to improve the efficiency of the application system of neural computing platform, and to overcome the limitations of traditional computers in the process of performing computing tasks, this paper proposes an application system of neural computing platform based on super computing. The application system combines three elements of grid computing, which are task management, task scheduling and resource management. Based on this, the operation process of the application system is mainly divided into two aspects, namely centralized scheduling of central servers, lightweight programs of super computing nodes. The research results show that the application system can improve the working efficiency of the application system of neural computing platform, and can process massive data information efficiently in multi-threading.

articleTitle: Research on Consumer Psychology Modeling and Intelligent Recommendation of E-commerce Users
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: To better understand the user’s behavior, depict the user’s psychological portrait, and provide intelligent services for e-commerce platform and users, this paper proposes a recommendation method based on users’ perceptual needs. In order to solve the problem of inaccurate recommendation results when the user’s awareness changes, a multi-attitude personalized recommendation algorithm is proposed, and the Bayesian network technology is used to establish the user’s network consumption psychological model. Then, according to the consumption behavior and psychological characteristics of different users, we can make personalized marketing plans. Finally, an example is provided to illustrate the rationality of the recommendation method from the perspective of the accuracy of the recommendation results, which provides a reference for analyzing the consumer psychology of users in e-commerce.

articleTitle: College English Paradigm in the Ubiquitous Learning Era: A Literature Review
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: Ubiquitous learning (u-learning) is an expansion of e-learning and mobile-assisted learning (m-learning). This paper is aimed to provide a review of the ubiquitous teaching paradigm within the specific area of College English as a foreign language. This article discusses, analyses and summarizes the basic concepts, theoretical basis, research approaches and points out the tendency of College English paradigm in the u-leaning era. The findings show that China’s College English learning has entered into the u-learning era with big data and AI+ as the two main features. The future researches are recommended to focus on the effectiveness of smart learning mode based on ecological theory.

articleTitle: Evaluation method of development level of Science and technology finance in Heilongjiang Province based on genetic projection Pursuit model
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: The traditional evaluation method for the development level of science and technology finance is affected by subjective factors, which results in index loss or evaluation data feature loss, which affects the reliability of evaluation results. Aiming at the above problems, the evaluation method of the development level of science and technology finance in Heilongjiang Province based on genetic projection pursuit model was studied. According to the principle of evaluation index selection, the evaluation index system of the development level of science and technology finance is established. After the data corresponding to the evaluation index are processed by projection pursuit model, the optimal projection direction is obtained by using genetic algorithm to complete the evaluation process. The example proves that the genetic algorithm can analyze the data more efficiently and the reliability of the evaluation results is better.

Author Keywords: Development level of science and finance

articleTitle: A Distributed Optical Fiber Monitoring Mine Pressure Prediction Model Based on Convolutional Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: In order to ensure the safe production of coal mines, this paper proposes a mine pressure prediction model based on convolutional neural network, which takes the optical fiber frequency shift data of the three-dimensional physical simulation test of similar materials to monitor the deformation of the overburden rock under mining as input, to predict the location of the next mine pressure on the working face. The BP neural network is used as a comparison algorithm, and the root mean square error (RMSE), average absolute error (MAE) and average absolute percentage error (MAPE) are used as the evaluation indicators of the mine pressure prediction model. The experimental results show that the RMSE, MAE and MAPE of the mine pressure prediction method based on the convolutional neural network proposed in this paper are lower than the BP neural network model, which has higher accuracy and robustness, and it provides a feasible scheme for realizing accurate mine pressure prediction.

articleTitle: Fuzzy AHP-Based Security Evaluation for Wireless Integrated Access System
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: Aiming at the threat and vulnerability of the heterogeneous wireless access system, this paper puts forward the index system of security risk assessment. Based on the analytic hierarchy process (AHP) and the fuzzy evaluation method, the fuzzy analytic hierarchy process (AHP) is adopted for the risk assessment of the system. This risk assessment method makes full use of the advantages of analytic hierarchy process and fuzzy evaluation method, and it has strong operability and accurate results, which provides reference for wireless network security risk assessment.

articleTitle: An Improved Traffic Sign Recognition Algorithm Based on Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: Aiming at the disadvantages of convolutional neural network in traffic sign recognition, such as poor real-time performance and high hardware requirements, an improved network based on lightweight convolutional neural network with real-time performance and high precision is proposed. On the one hand, depthwise separable convolution and activation function Mish are introduced to speed up the network training and recognition speed and reduce the requirements for hardware devices; on the other hand, through the improvement of network architecture and level, the size and number of convolution cores are reasonably changed to enhance the expression and transmission of image features. The experimental results on the traffic sign dataset of Belgium TSC show that the improved network significantly improves the network training speed, and the recognition accuracy is slightly higher than that of the original network, which verifies the effectiveness of the improved method. Compared with other models, this model can complete the task of traffic sign recognition more quickly and accurately, which verifies the feasibility of this method.

articleTitle: A Sensor Fault Diagnosis Algorithm for UAV Based on Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: To improve the security and reliability of the system in case of sensor failure, a fault diagnosis algorithm based on neural network is proposed to locate the fault quickly and reconstruct the control system in this paper. Firstly, the typical airborne sensors are introduced and their common failure modes are analyzed. Then, a new method of complex feature extraction using wavelet packet is put forward to extract the fault characteristics of UAV sensors. Finally, the observer method based on BP neural network is adopted to train and acquire data offline, and to detect and process single or multiple sensor faults online. Matlab simulation results show that the algorithm has good diagnostic accuracy and strong generalization ability, which also has certain practicability in engineering.

articleTitle: Research on Feature Extraction and Tendency Analysis of Chinese Language Sentimental Expression in Network Context
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: The current network language only considers the expression of its basic meaning, and lacks in-depth analysis of sentimental characteristics and tendencies. For this reason, this paper investigates the sentimental analysis methods of network language based on the Chinese text information of network social media platform. Through the training of the existing data sets, we complete the data cleaning and feature word extraction. Then, a multi-dimensional fine-grained sentiment classification algorithm is designed by using neural network to reduce the dimension of feature vector. Finally, the structured linguistic features are used to optimize the sentiment score step by step, and the text sentiment classification is implemented, and a tendency analysis model considering the polarity of sentiment is further established. The validity of the model is verified by the real data collected in the network. The results show that the method has a significant advantage in Chinese data sets, and the recognition rate is higher than that of similar sentiment analysis methods.

articleTitle: Intelligent Guide System of Scenic Spot Based on Visual Communication
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: To better play the role of new media in the intelligent scenic spot guidance system, computer technology is integrated into each part of the guidance system and put into the scenic spot. Thus, this paper performs the optimization design of virtual and real integration of the visual communication based scenic spot guidance system and intelligent APP. Our smart tourism system is designed from the overall architecture of the system to the functional modules of the system, which adopts the C/S software architecture system, and it is combined with mobile Internet development, WebService, MVC and other technologies. We also design and implement the relevant functional modules of the scenic spot guidance of the smart tourism system, and provide the design of the database table. Through the combination of online and offline, the tourist guide system is designed to establish multi-dimensional interaction with tourists and optimize the experience mode of tourism information.

articleTitle: Research on Selection Model of Rural Passenger Transport Service Supply Mode
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: With the implementation of Rural Revitalization Strategy, how to play the most effective role of local government in the development of rural passenger transport has attracted people's attention. In order to provide theoretical methods for the local government to scientifically choose the supply mode of rural passenger transport service, this paper puts forward the adaptability evaluation method of rural passenger transport service supply mode. In this paper, we build the index system of technology, economy, government, market and society on the characteristics of different public service supply modes in rural passenger service supply, adopt the method of combining Delphi and analytic hierarchy process and put forward the calculation method to determine the influence intensity and weight of index, use fuzzy calculation to calculate the adaptability of rural passenger service supply mode in a certain area. The ease calculation shows that the evaluation results of this method can help the local government to select the suitable rural passenger transport service supply mode scientifically.

articleTitle: BISMF Algorithm based on Probability Matrix Decomposition Model
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: In order to alleviate the problem of data sparsity and cold start, and improve the prediction accuracy, in this paper, we combine the user’s social network and scoring records, based on the existing work, based on the existing Bayesian probabilistic matrix factorization model, a Bayesian improved social matrix factorization algorithm based on probabilistic matrix factorization model is proposed. The experimental results show that the prediction accuracy of our method is higher than the existing methods.

articleTitle: Design and Research of Intelligent Recommendation and Management System for Scenic Spots Based on Mobile Platform
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: to further meet the needs of tourists in the scenic area and make the whole journey of the scenic area more intelligent, humanized and refined, this paper designs and implements a scenic area intelligent recommendation and management service system under Android platform, based on the existing personalized recommendation research. According to the design scheme, we implement each function module of the system, and realize the specific functions from the server and the mobile terminal. The core intelligent recommendation module analyzes the customer’s behavior by obtaining the location and other situational information, using the hybrid content recommendation and personalized recommendation technology. It adopts the weighted average method to calculate the user’s interest. Finally, this paper develops and tests the smart tourism system based on Android development platform, and the results show that the smart tourism system of the mobile platform basically achieves the expected goal and runs stably.

articleTitle: Evaluation and Analysis of Regional Ecological Service Value based on Data Analysis Method
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: In order to analyze the positive or negative effects of land use on regional ecological service system. In this paper, an ecological service evaluation model is established, which measures ecological services from the following 8 aspects: product supply, water supply, water purification, climate regulation, soil conservation, carbon sequestration and oxygen release, tourism & entertainment and biodiversity. A comprehensive evaluation model of ecological service based on grey relational degree analysis and entropy weight method is established. The influence of ecological service value evaluation model on land-use planners and project managers is analyzed, and Xi’an city and Longxian County in Shaanxi Province were taken as evaluation objects.

articleTitle: Simulation Analysis of Avionics System of UAV Based on MATLAB
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: Aiming at the problems of long simulation time and high mean square error in traditional UAV avionics system simulation analysis methods, a simulation analysis method of UAV avionics system based on MATLAB is proposed. By analyzing the basic data of avionics system, the simulation model of UAV avionics system is constructed. Based on the analysis of avionics system, the system simulation credibility model is constructed. The trust value of credibility model includes three aspects: subjective trust value, direct trust value and recommended trust value. The final credibility value of electronic system credibility is derived from the three trust values. According to the final trust value, the subjective discrimination method is used to calculate the reliability of avionics system qualitative index, the subjective weight value of reliability index and the objective weight value of reliability index, and the evaluation results are given according to the comprehensive weight value of the index. On the basis of the above, the reliability evaluation index of the whole avionics system is screened by using MATLAB, and the evaluation is completed. Combined with the simulation program design of UAV avionics system, the simulation analysis of UAV avionics system is realized. The experimental results show that the simulation analysis method of UAV avionics system based on Matlab can effectively shorten the simulation analysis time and reduce the mean square error.

articleTitle: Comprehensive evaluation and classification of urban economic benefits under typical correlation analysis
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: Since the reform and opening up, the urban economy has gradually become the main body of the national economy. In order to strengthen the evaluation of urban economic benefits is an important link in improving urban economic benefits. Based on the research on the relevant factors of urban economic efficiency, this paper selects the input and output elements of the city from a variety of factors, and establishes a definite expression of the comprehensive benefits of the city based on the selection. This article first uses the systematic clustering method to classify 30 regions, and then uses canonical correlation analysis to find several comprehensive variables between the original two sets of variables into a few pairs of comprehensive variables. Through the comprehensive application of the canonical correlation analysis method and the systematic clustering method, the relevant scores of each city are further obtained. This method can reduce the dimension of data, quickly find out the correlation of variables and classify them. The final results show that the evaluation results and ranking are in line with reality, which has a certain reference value for the evaluation standards of cities in the future.

articleTitle: A Computer Aided Creative Design Method for Cultural Products
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: In view of the existing problems in the creative modeling design of cultural products, this paper uses case-based design technology to establish a multi-objective optimization model for the concept of cultural and creative products. Through the in-depth study of design elements related to product modeling, we propose a personalized product design process based on user characteristics and images. Then, based on the innovative design method and procedure of the case, the knowledge classification of product appearance design is summarized, and the design method is applied to the innovative design of product form concept. Finally, combined with SPSS data analysis, database technology and Visual C+ to complete the design of the case product modeling innovation scheme. The experimental results show that the scheme can assist designers in the creative design of cultural and creative products, and realize the automation of product retrieval and storage supported by computer.

articleTitle: Research on Indoor Positioning Method Based on Terminal Clustering
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: In the dynamic indoor positioning environment, the traditional indoor positioning model will increase the positioning error and computational complexity with the increase of the number of positioning targets. This paper proposes a terminal clustering method based on the minimum Mahalanobis distance, which can provide good positioning services for multiple terminals at the same time and improve the positioning efficiency of the indoor positioning system. At the same time, two-level precoding is used to effectively overcome the inter cluster interference and intra cluster interference in the terminal cluster, and improve the positioning accuracy. In addition, the spatial sphere weighted centroid method based on the channel covariance matrix makes full use of the channel information between each node and the terminal, which is more targeted for the channel environment (including geomorphic features and surrounding buildings, etc.), so as to improve the quality of service.

articleTitle: Development and optimization of rotation drying silo
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: The grain storage loss is serious in farm after harvest due to lack of storage and drying technologies. A new drying silo was developed based on the idea of letting the grain "move", changing from passive drying to active drying. It is used not only for drying but also for short term storage. Also, it can be compiled with mechanical ventilation and heating. The field studies showed that our rotating silo can be used for reducing the grain moisture to safe level in an economic way and keep the quantity and quality of grain safe. This provides a strong support for the reduction loss in the post-harvest section with energy-saving.

articleTitle: Human Resource Allocation Method Based on Multi Objective Optimization
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: To realize the reasonable assignment of employees' tasks, this paper proposes a multi-objective human resource allocation model based on genetic algorithm for the multistage combinatorial optimization problem. We analyzed the basic idea of the resource allocation model, established the necessary network model and a multi-objective mathematical model. Then, the global optimal solution can be found by searching from the point set with the objective of optimizing the three practical indexes of reasonable grouping. Finally, a multi-objective optimization method based on genetic algorithm was proposed to solve the model, and it was verified by an example case. The experimental results showed that the method can maximize the sum of the effective cumulative rate of all the roles who undertake the task, and it had the characteristics of clear logic, simple calculation and practical application value.

articleTitle: Research on visualization method of educational resources based on intelligent classroom
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: In order to solve the problems of the long existence of traditional visualization methods of educational resources and low user satisfaction, this paper studies a visualization method of educational resources based on intelligent classroom. The framework of intelligent classroom data analysis is designed, the data mining model of intelligent classroom education resources is constructed, and the mined resource data is integrated and processed. Based on the integration results of intelligent classroom education resource data, the data set is processed hierarchically according to the length of data encoding, and the visualization of education resource is realized by combining the time dimension of parallel coordinate system. The experimental results show that the maximum visualization time of educational resources in this method is only 3.56s, and the average user satisfaction score is 9.6. The visualization efficiency and user satisfaction of educational resources are both high.

articleTitle: Japanese Teaching Environment Construction Based on Virtual Reality Technology
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: In order to make up for the limitation of traditional Japanese teaching space, this paper adopt virtual reality technology to provide an immersive interactive learning environment for teachers and students. The scheme uses B/S three-tier system to establish a computer supported cooperative work system. Then, by the introduction of VR technology, ASP.NET and front-end design, a web-based virtual teaching environment is constructed. Finally, the VR platform is used to create a virtual scene instance for Japanese teaching. The experimental results show that the scheme realizes the human-computer interaction function in virtual experiment teaching, and shows better scalability and security.

articleTitle: Visualization Digital System of Digital Museum Based on Big Data Technology
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: In order to overcome the difficulties faced by traditional museums in the era of big data, this paper proposes a novel visualization digital system of digital museum based on big data technology. The system fully combines the advantages of big data technology, according to the characteristics of Museum big data to the museum data perception, collection, processing, analysis and storage process. Based on this, the system also makes full use of advanced visualization technology, and can present the processing results and analysis results of Museum big data to users in various forms. The results show that the system can accelerate the transformation and upgrading of traditional museums, and improve the economic and social benefits of museums.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of College Music Teaching Management System
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: To solve the poor reusability and portability of traditional three-tier architecture teaching system, this paper first analyzes and models the system with UML, and provides the implementation process of music teaching management system based on J2EE platform and B/S architecture. The scheme uses MyEclipse 10 as the development tool, MSSQL2016 as the database management tool, and JSP as the front-end interface. It adopts JDBC to achieve asynchronous communication with the server, and finally puts forward a rich and friendly user interface in the web page, to provide users non-refresh visual experience. Finally, the function, performance and interface of the system are tested, and the results show that the system can get the expected effect, which also achieves all kinds of requirements in the demand analysis, and improves the efficiency and level of the whole university educational business.

articleTitle: A Method of Making Shortwave Skywave Communication Contact Document based on Automatic Frequency Selection and Document Generation
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: In order to overcome the problems of tedious generation process, difficult and unscientific frequency point selection, this paper proposes a method of scientific frequency selection and fast generation of contact file. This method collects the parameters of the contact file such as the longitude and latitude of the receiving and sending places through the program, calls the frequency selection software V, calculates the frequency, antenna angle and other data in combination with the sunspot data of the past few cycles, generates the contact file automatically by COM technology, and generates other contact file parameters automatically by pseudo-random number generation method. The results show that using the software made by the method proposed in this paper to make the contact document, the work intensity is reduced. In addition, the antenna erection height and other parameters that the original contact document does not have can guide the follow-up communication work, and the communication passability is greatly improved.

articleTitle: Preparation and Corrosion Properties of Graphene Oxide Modified Waterborne Epoxy Zinc-Rich Coatings
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: In order to overcome the agglomeration of graphene oxide (GO) in the water-based zinc-rich epoxy coating (WZRE), so as to achieve the purpose of improving the corrosion resistance of the WZRE coating. The paper proposes a method of modifying graphene oxide with L-tryptophan (Trp) and L-lysine (Ly). The method involves grafting the amino groups of L-Trp and L-Ly with the carboxyl and epoxy groups on the surface of graphene oxide. After grafting, the amide reaction is used to form an amide bond (-CO-NH-) and the nucleophilic ring-opening reaction is used to form a C-N bond, modified graphene oxide can be uniformly dispersed in water-based epoxy zinc-rich coatings. The results of infrared spectroscopy, Raman spectroscopy and scanning electron microscopy showed that L-tryptophan (Trp) and L-lysine (Ly) were successfully grafted on the surface of GO through chemical bonds. Electrochemical impedance spectroscopy and Tafel polarization curve experiments showed that When the WZRE coating is added with 0.2% L-Trp-GO and 0.2% L-Ly-GO respectively, the corrosion resistance of the coating is significantly improved. Among them, the L-Trp-GO/WZRE coating has the best resistance Corrosion performance, its corrosion rate is one order of magnitude lower than WZRE and L-Ly-GO/WZRE.

articleTitle: Design of tourism marketing management system based on SWOT analysis
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: In order to improve the accuracy and efficiency of tourism marketing management system, this paper proposes and designs a tourism marketing management system based on SWOT analysis. Under the premise of clear system requirements and functions, the overall architecture and network architecture of the system are designed. On this basis, the hardware of the system is designed. The main hardware of the system includes user login module, tourism marketing information management module and tourism market information database to meet the needs of the system. In the software design part of the system, the advantage opportunity type in SWOT analysis method is used to process the tourism marketing data and calculate the mapping feature dimension of the tourism marketing data, so as to improve the management efficiency and effectiveness of the system. The experimental results show that, compared with the traditional tourism marketing management system, the designed system has higher management accuracy and shorter management time. Therefore, the management system designed in this paper has stronger management performance and can meet the needs of tourism marketing management.

articleTitle: BIM Based Project Investment Cost Control Strategy in Big Data Environment
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: In order to overcome the problems of low efficiency and poor control effect of traditional investment cost control strategies, this paper designs a project investment cost control strategy based on BIM under the environment of big data. We discuss the basic knowledge of dynamic control of investment cost by using data model, and focus on the application of BIM in project cost control. The materials are integrated through standard BIM data interface and 4D model schedule. Then, the project schedule simulation and collision detection collaborative module of BIM are fully used to complete the calculation and distribution of specific workload. The experimental results show that compared with the traditional control strategy, the time consuming of the proposed control scheme is shorter, and the cost waste is less after the application of the proposed strategy, which proves that the proposed strategy effectively promotes the integration of engineering design and engineering cost control, and the control effect is good.

articleTitle: Research on Positioning Accuracy of Five-station Time Difference Positioning Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: In order to determine the selection strategy of the positioning algorithm of the five-station time difference positioning system, the analysis algorithm and the least square algorithm of the five-station time difference positioning are compared and studied. First, the time difference positioning model and algorithm error model of the two algorithms are given, and the Cramer-Rao threshold of the time difference positioning accuracy is derived. Then, under the conditions of different time difference measurement errors and station site error parameters, the positioning performance of the two algorithms is simulated and analyzed. The simulation results show that the positioning accuracy of the least squares positioning algorithm can reach the Cramer-Rao threshold, which is higher than that of the analytical positioning algorithm.

articleTitle: Application of Swarm Intelligence Optimization Algorithm in Antenna Design
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: Traditional intelligent algorithm cannot optimize multiple parameters at the same time, so the optimization effect is poor. In order to solve such problem, swarm intelligence optimization algorithm is used in the antenna design. By analyzing the influence parameters, we design the objective function and adopt chaos optimization algorithm to optimize the initial population selection of particle swarm optimization. Then, according to the actual design requirements, the improved particle swarm optimization(PSO) algorithm is used to solve multiple optimization problems, and the optimal design of the antenna is also realized. The simulation results show that our scheme optimizes the design effect, and the antenna has larger directional gain, which effectively improves the comprehensive performance of antenna.

articleTitle: Application Model of China’s Governance Method Based on Big Data
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: In order to research and explore China's international governance system and strengthen the approach to the application of big data in the national governance system, this paper presents a novel application model of China's governance method based on big data. The application model is based on 829 Big Data policy texts in China from 2012 to 2018, and scientifically employs social network analysis methods to study and explore the evolutionary characteristics of Big Data policy thematic networks. The research results show that in this application model, big data policy themes are diverse and continuous, and they have three main forms, namely policy innovation, policy continuity and policy cohesion.

articleTitle: Controller Failure Recovery Strategy for Software Defined Flying Ad-hoc Network Based on Latency and Node State
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: In order to overcome the problem of network paralysis caused by control node failure in current software defined flying ad-hoc networks (SD-FANET), this paper proposes a backup control node selection method based on latency and node state. This method combines the characteristics of network node energy limitation and link instability, and sets the corresponding energy detection method and timeout detection mechanism to judge whether the control node is invalid. After determining the control node failure, the node availability is calculated according to the network feedback parameters such as link latency, joint strength and node energy. Based on this, the backup control node is selected, and the backup control node completes the networking again according to the backup data received from the control node, so as to complete the failure recovery. The simulation results show that, compared with the existing election strategy, the proposed method can effectively reduce the number of messages and recovery latency in the process of recovery failure, and can quickly complete the failure recovery with lower network overhead; moreover, compared with the random selection algorithm, the failure recovery rate of the algorithm is improved by more than 38%, which can ensure the reliability and practicability of the network to a greater extent.

articleTitle: Multi-scale Feature Fusion in Wireless Propagation Model Optimization Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: In order to address the effects of various environmental variables on radio propagation and improve the quality of radio propagation. Inspired by the traditional empirical classification method and based on an artificial environment, this paper improves the experiments on the path well prediction results of the wireless propagation model according to the optimization algorithm with satellite remote sensing images as the input data of the network, and selects RESNet50 with the highest recognition efficiency by comparing the experimental data of eight deep learning networks such as VGG16 and RESNet50 under the self-built wireless transmission environment. By adding a feature pyramid to the network, the recognition accuracy of environmental variables reaches 96.4%, and the recognition time is 1.29 seconds per 1000 samples.

articleTitle: Development and implementation of personalized health assessment management system based on J2EE
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: In view of the large number of users in the health examination center, the variety of business involved, and the high requirements for the robustness and scalability of the system architecture, this paper puts forward the design of personalized health assessment management system based on J2EE. On the basis of in-depth analysis of the C/S and B/S development modes, the n-tier distributed system based on J2EE architecture is established by comprehensively using J2EE development technology. The business logic of the system is divided into five independent layers: web layer, business appearance layer, business rule layer, data entity layer and data access layer. The evaluation rule management module realizes the function of data management of evaluation rules through the Internet. The evaluation classifier module implements the function that the users of the health examination center classify the evaluation data of service objects according to the evaluation rule data and the health examination data of service objects generated by the evaluation rule management module. The personal health management prescription generator module realizes the function of generating personal health management prescription according to the evaluation data generated by the evaluation classifier module.

articleTitle: Comparison Studies on the Evacuation Impacts of Exit Angle Based on Simulation Dynamics and Animal Experiment
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: In order to overcome the problem that lacking empirical evacuation data limited the thorough study of the social force model and explore the importance of exit angle under panic situations, a new method which combines dynamic simulation and animal experiment is proposed. In this method, empirical data are obtained from the simulation process based on the social force model and ant experiment using panic ants in chambers with five different exit angles. Through the combination and comparison of simulation and ant experiment, it is desired to know whether the social force model can well describe the crowds’ behavior under panic situations during evacuation and the influence of different exit angles on evacuation efficiency. The results show that the social force model is overall reasonable and suitable, for its description of the changing trend of evacuation time roughly coincides with that in ant experiment. However, it still has some limitations. For instance, it could not describe some specific features and phenomena found in ant experiment. Besides, the 180° exit, which is typical in the daily life, is not the best choice for evacuation under panic situations, while the 150° exit performs the best in simulation and ant experiment. The results suggest that the social force model needs further improvement to better explain some newfound phenomena and characteristics, and a 150° exit can be taken into consideration for the exit facility design in some large crowded places.

articleTitle: Logistics management data security transmission system based on Internet of things technology
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: The logistics management of colleges and universities involves all aspects of basic data, with a large amount of data and many kinds. The traditional data analysis and statistics method not only takes a long time, but also has a low degree of security, so it is difficult for the management department to obtain useful data from a large number of data in time. Based on this, a logistics management data security transmission system based on Internet of things technology is designed. By optimizing the configuration of data processing and management hardware structure, the goal of data acquisition and effect display is realized, and the data acquisition and processing process of logistics management information system based on big data is optimized, which effectively ensures the movement safety of logistics data management system, The logistics management data security transmission system based on Internet of things technology has high practicability in the practical application process, and plays an important role in promoting green construction.

articleTitle: Parameters Predictions of Paddy Grain Drying Based on Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: In order to improve the drying efficiency and guarantee the grain quality after drying, this paper proposed to use artificial intelligence modelling to predict the grain quality indexes after drying. With air temperature, air relative humidity, initial moisture content, air velocity and tempering rate as control parameters, three models were established, and the prediction performance of these three models was tested. The three models were regression model, Back-propagation Neural Network (BPNN) and Deep Neural Network (DNN). The results showed that the machine learning techniques, in particular DNN had the best performance, especially for predicting germination rate ratio. The contribution of this paper is to demonstrate the ability of machine learning techniques in fitting grain drying characteristics with different control parameters. This paper proved the applicability of machine learning technology in grain drying field, and established the corresponding models.
