articleTitle: Lossless restoration of local blurred image based on deep residual network
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: In the process of digital image transmission, it is easy to be affected by the environmental conditions, which leads to the local blur problem of digital image. Therefore, a local blur image lossless restoration method based on deep residual network is proposed. The identity mapping is set in the deep residual training network layer to obtain the structure of the new residual unit. Combined with the weight matrix of local fuzzy image segmentation, the edge of local fuzzy image is segmented. The fuzzy parameters of local fuzzy image are calculated, and the fuzzy wavelet method is used to calculate the fuzzy degree and fuzzy peak value of local fuzzy image. Finally, the lossless restoration formula of local blurred image is obtained to realize the lossless restoration of local blurred image. The experimental results show that, compared with the traditional restoration method, the restoration efficiency of this method is significantly improved, the highest restoration efficiency is 93%, and the restored image has higher definition.

articleTitle: Credit Decision-Making Problems of Small, Medium and Micro Enterprises Based on Risk Assessment
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: In order to overcome the credit decision problem of MSMEs, a novel model is constructed in this paper. The model is divided into three main categories, which are comprehensive evaluation model, cluster analysis model and hierarchical analysis model. In addition, the model uses MATLAB algorithms to obtain the optimal credit strategy. Based on this, the model also performs quantitative analysis of credit risk, measuring credit risk in terms of both reputation and strength, and finally obtains a comprehensive ranking of reputation and strength, i.e. the ranking of credit risk. In addition, for the determination of the credit strategy, this paper adopts the comprehensive evaluation method, taking the quality degree of the enterprise (from the bank’s perspective) as the evaluation object, establishing a rating index system with annual yield, reputation, sales and gross profit rate as the evaluation indicators, and using the weighted average method to establish a comprehensive evaluation model. Considering the large amount of data, Excel was used to process the data. , and MATLAB was used to obtain the final research results. The results of the study showed that the enterprises considering the loans were mainly divided into five grades, with the ratio of the actual loan amount to the expected loan amount in each grade ranging from [85%, 90%], [75%, 80%], [70%, 75%], [65%, 70%] and [60%, 65%] intervals.

articleTitle: Design of coupling compensation method for transmission error of small and medium modulus precision gears in CNC machine tools
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: In order to improve the effectiveness and efficiency of gear transmission error compensation, a coupling compensation method for small and medium modulus precision gear transmission error of CNC machine tools is proposed. Firstly, the gear transmission error is calculated, including the radial runout linear error, the axial movement linear error and the linear error caused by the accumulated pitch error. After the error calculation, the transmission function of the gear is calculated, and the transmission function is solved to complete the coupling compensation of transmission error. The experimental results show that compared with the traditional transmission error coupling compensation method, the transmission error of the proposed method is significantly reduced, and the compensation time is lower, which can meet the actual processing requirements of CNC machine tools.

articleTitle: Research on Intelligent Evaluation Method of Management Informatization Construction Mode of Small and Medium Sized Enterprises
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: In order to provide a complete set of general evaluation index system and comprehensive evaluation method for manufacturing enterprise informatization, this paper adopts the principal component analysis method to determine the weight of evaluation index based on the establishment of small and medium-sized enterprise informatization evaluation index system. It takes a sample enterprise as an example, and proposes an intelligent calculation and evaluation method of enterprise informatization index. The scheme makes full use of the key operations such as principal component analysis, SPSS tools and integrated information platform planning and design to complete the comprehensive evaluation of enterprise informatization construction, obtains the index of small contribution rate in the process of small and medium-sized enterprise management informatization, which further analyzes the factors that need to be improved and provides future development decisions for enterprises.

articleTitle: A Novel Approach to Implement Price Banding with Dynamic Implied Volatility Surface
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: In order to overcome the problem of Fat finger when the liquidity of options could not obtain a significant variety, a new implement price banding method was proposed. The proposed method uses the dynamic implied volatility surface to improve the price banding efficiency for Fat finger problem.First, we choose the "two-step" method to build a dynamic model. We fit an implied volatility surface to each cross-section of options by two factors: moneyness and time to expiration, then we model and forecast the estimated volatility function coefficients by VAR. Then, we take the price calculated by the model as the banding reference price, and establish the checking range for orders. The experiment result shows that the proposed method outperforms the other similar researches in prediction accuracy aspect, especially for soybean meal options with low liquidity. Moreover, it could remarkably keep the market far away from freezing, which powerfully protects the derivatives market's administration.

articleTitle: Analysis on the Training System of Archives Managers in Colleges and Universities Based on Dynamic Programming Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: Dynamic planning is a method to solve the optimization problem of multi-stage decision-making process. It is characterized by transforming the multi-stage decision-making problem into a series of interrelated single-stage problems and then solving them one by one. The personality education of archivists is crucial to the construction of archival information resources. This article elaborates the connotation and role of the personality of archives administrators in colleges and universities, and addresses the current status and problems of the lack of personality education. It proposes to strengthen the cultivation of the professional ethics and information literacy of the archives management personnel in colleges and universities, enhances professional self-confidence, and eliminates negative feelings of burnout. To improve professional skills and to promote the development of university archives management. This paper describes the system structure of planning and scheduling, and then uses the principle of dynamic programming to solve the problem of multi-task competitive resources in planning and scheduling. The solution and optimal solution obtained by dynamic programming algorithm only have the error caused by state quantization.

articleTitle: Correlation Filtering Tracking Algorithm with Joint Scale Estimation and Occlusion processing
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: An improved correlation filtering algorithm is proposed to address the problems of the traditional correlation filtering algorithm in solving the scale changes and occlusion problems. First, by establishing a scale pyramid, the algorithm can effectively adapt to the change of target scale. In addition, an occlusion detection mechanism is added in the model update stage, and the peak-to-edge ratio is used to determine whether the model needs to be updated, so that the algorithm can better handle the occlusion scenes. Based on what mentioned above, the improved algorithm can achieve adaptive target tracking under scale changes and occlusion. The simulation results show that the algorithm can effectively improve the scale estimation and occlusion performance compared with other related algorithms.

articleTitle: Research on the Configuration Method of Cross-domain VPN-OptionC Mode Based on RR
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: At present, single-domain MPLS VPN is widely used. In many services, MPLS VPN across multiple autonomous systems is required. Nowadays, three main cross-domain VPN technologies are used at home and abroad. This thesis mainly discusses the third VPN-OptionC used to reduce the burden of ASBR. In this paper a typical VPN-OptionC model is used to introduce the configuration methods and considerations in detail. Meanwhile, the configuration requirements and the ideas and methods for solving practical problems are analyzed. Finally, the corresponding configuration process and phase detection methods are proposed in order to reduce the number of failures.

articleTitle: Performance Optimization Scheme of Vehicle-Mounted Computing Platform Based on OpenGL
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: In order to overcome the problems of insufficient computing power in complex computing scenarios due to hardware limitations of vehicle-mounted embedded devices and too low rendering frame rate in multi-element rendering, a new comprehensive optimization method is proposed. First, this method converts the large number of floating-point numbers that originally needed to be calculated in the CPU into texture data, also, performs parallel calculations by OpenGL in the GPU, which solves the efficiency problem of the on-board system when a large number of floating-point is calculated. At the same time, this method constructs a directed acyclic graph based on the FrameGraph architecture, which can effectively improve the performance of rendering a large number of elements. On the basic of the above, it can improve the calculation speed of forward computing scenarios that require deep learning such as face recognition and pedestrian detection, and solve the efficiency problem of rendering a large number of elements in the vehicle large screen auxiliary display. The experimental results show that the proposed method can reduce the computing time by 33%, and the rendering frame time by 14%.

articleTitle: Research on Resource Scheduling Algorithm for The Cloud
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: With the rapid development of cloud computing, how to allocate the reasonable resources to the task according to the different needs of users has become the core of cloud task scheduling. Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO) algorithm is simple and convergent to the optimal solution, but it easily falls into the local optimal solution at the optimization process. In this paper, the probabilistic sampling of the simulated annealing algorithm (SA) is added to the PSO algorithm to improve the shortcomings of the PSO-SA algorithm. This purpose is that it not only avoids failing into the local optimal solution, but also ensures the diversity of the population. By introducing the trust relation into the task scheduling problem of the cloud, it has been combined with the PSO-SA algorithm. Finally, the effectiveness of the algorithm is verified by using of CloudSim. The experimental results show that the PSO-SA algorithm can meet the requirements of the reliability of cloud service quality.

articleTitle: An Intelligent Evaluation Method of Japanese Teachers' Educational Ability Based on MOOC Environment
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: With the continuous integration of information technology into college teaching, the traditional single evaluation method has been unable to meet the needs of teachers' network teaching evaluation activities in the new era. Therefore, this paper discusses the limitations of the traditional use of MOOC resources for Japanese teaching, and proposes a teaching quality evaluation mechanism based on neural network. At the same time, genetic algorithm based on adaptive mutation probability is used to optimize the initial weights and thresholds of BP neural network to enhance the prediction accuracy and generalization ability of the model. The experimental analysis shows that the MOOC teaching evaluation model based on the improved BP neural network algorithm provides full play to the advantages of the artificial neural network, effectively weakens the artificial factors in determining the index weight, thus improving the teaching quality and providing a favorable mechanism for the intelligent evaluation of Japanese teaching quality.

articleTitle: The Optimization and Analysis of Sandcastle Model
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: In order to get the best geometry of sand castle, in this paper, the energy loss method, iterative method and control variable method are used to analyze the stress of sand castle. Firstly, according to the law of sea water energy loss, the optimal three-dimensional geometric shape of sand castle is a round platform using the iterative method, the results show that the tilt angle of the round platform is 1.203 ~ 1.267 (RAD), and the time of sand castle maintenance is the longest when the sea water depth is 2.6 ~ 3.2cm. secondly, the optimal water to sand mixing ratio of sand castle is 1:12 by using the assignment method. Finally, the influence of rain erosion on the life of sand castle is considered, and some suggestions are put forward according to the analysis results.

articleTitle: Big Data Analysis and Optimization Strategy of Tourism Participation Behavior in Ethnic Communities
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: To accurately evaluate the current situation of ethnic community tourism participation in China, this paper analyzes the reasons for the low-level operation of ethnic community tourism participation system based on the advanced experience of big data embedded in tourism public service supply. We use system dynamics as a theoretical tool to summarize the influencing factors and main indicators of community tourism decision-making behavior. Combining with the information entropy model and AHP model, this paper finds out the important factors that cause the dilemma of ethnic community tourism participation through quantitative form. Finally, the paper analyzes the potential of ethnic community tourism participation through a specific case, and proves the effectiveness of the model through the experimental results, and puts forward the system optimization strategy from the perspective of new institutional economics, so as to provide a scientific path for the optimization of tourism participation behavior.

articleTitle: Design of A New Type Horizontal Rotary Drying Chamber
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: In order to overcome the adverse effect of traditional grain drier on grain quality, a new type horizontal rotary drying chamber was designed and developed. The characteristic of this equipment is that the grain is dried at low temperature, and the whole machine rotates slowly to stir the grain, so as to ensure the uniformity of moisture content after the grain is dried, reduce the mechanical damage to grain in the drying process, and ensure the grain drying quality. In order to verify the performance of the equipment, a corn drying test was carried out. After 48 hours of continuous drying, the moisture content (24% wet basic) of 30.8t newly harvested high-moisture corn was dried to 15%, the drying curve was smooth, the drying process was stable, the non-uniformity after drying was less than 1%, and the unit energy consumption was about 0.19 kW-h/ (1% moisture -t). The experimental results showed that the moisture content of corn after drying was uniform, and the energy consumption was low. Therefore, it is a new warehouse type suitable for large farmers’ corn drying and short-term storage, and provides a new technology method and idea for grain drying and storage in the future.

articleTitle: Architecture Design and Switching Control Strategy of Integrated Operation System of Zone Type Microgrid
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: To ensure the stable mode switching of zone type microgrid, this paper proposes an integrated control system for the microgrid. Firstly, the micro grid structure, control analysis and operation mode are modeled and analyzed. Then, in the overall control strategy deployment of the system, we focus on the two operation methods of inverter technology in independent operation and grid connected operation. The droop control network inverter and the traditional synchronous generator cooperate with each other to coordinate the operation control, and the droop control and V/f control are integrated to complete the smooth switching process of microgrid island/grid connected operation. The simulation results show that the proposed scheme has the function of regulating the microgrid network and can achieve smooth transition of multiple functions. At the same time, it has strong anti-interference ability and excellent stability.

articleTitle: Fatigue driving detection method based on multi-task cascaded convolutional network
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: Fatigue driving has become an important cause of traffic accidents, but fatigue driving detection methods are still in the preliminary stage of development. Detection methods based on driver’s physiological characteristics are expensive, and detection methods based on vehicle motion characteristics are low in accuracy. In order to overcome the difficult problem of fatigue driving detection, the paper proposes a method based on multi-task cascaded neural network (MTCNN), which uses key point coordinate detection of human face, three courtyards and five eyes to locate human eyes, eye aspect ratio (EAR) to detect fatigue and other methods to detect fatigue driving with high accuracy, non- invasive, low cost and other advantages. The experimental results show that the proposed scheme has improved detection accuracy and reduced detection time compared with Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN), which provides reliable technical support for the research on fatigue driving detection.

articleTitle: Reserch on Driver Body Monitoring System for Risk Sources of Intelligent Transportation
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: With the rapid development of science and technology, intelligent transportation is also booming, and the safety of intelligent transportation has been paid more and more attention. Among accidents, car accidents occupy the first place, accounting for more than 50% of the total number of accidental deaths. Taking automobile accidents as an example, the number of deaths due to traffic accidents in the world has exceeded 30 million, more than the number of deaths in the world war. People, cars, and roads are the three elements of traffic, of which people are the most uncertain factor. In order to reduce car accidents caused by the driver’s body, this paper proposes a STM32-based wireless monitoring method for the driver’s critical life. This method uses ADS1292 and LMT70 collects the driver’s heart rate and body temperature data, the collected data is further processed by STM32, and the processed data is uploaded to the upper computer via WiFi, and the analysis shows. This method can effectively reduce the accident rate caused by drivers and provide a basis for solving the safety problems of intelligent transportation.

articleTitle: Research on Multi Strategy intelligent interactive translation and related issues on mobile platform
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: Based on the existing research results, this paper studies the Multi Strategy intelligent interactive translation and related issues on the mobile platform. In Multi Strategy intelligent interactive translation, a variety of models are used, including translation model, language model, sentence length penalty model, reordering distance limit model, lexicalized reordering model. In the Multi Strategy intelligent interactive translation, the decoding method of left to right style is mainly used, that is, the source language phrases are constantly selected for translation, and the target language sentences are continuously generated in the way of left to right. The reason why we adopt this left to right approach is that it just meets the matching requirements of translation prefix. Based on the mobile platform, the interactive mode of Multi Strategy intelligent interactive translation is designed. The traditional interactive process is divided into three processes: "phrase splitting - phrase translation item confirmation - re Decoding". The interpreter can directly select the correct translation item for the source language in the loaded phrase translation item list to guide the computer decoding. The Hong Kong Chinese English Parallel Corpus of LDC20001 is selected as the experimental corpus for the comparative experiment. The experimental results show that the proposed method can reduce the translation time, reduce the cognitive burden, reduce the translation time and improve the translation efficiency.

articleTitle: Fault location method for 66KV transmission line based on fault region search
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: In order to solve the disadvantages of the traditional transmission line fault location method, such as high location error rate and long location output time, this paper proposes a 66KV transmission line fault location method based on fault region search. Traveling wave method is used to build mathematical model of 66KV transmission line and the model is used to determine the fault section and fault distance, when the fault distance is greater than the segment length, thinks that fault occurred in the downstream, at this time to need to divide the fault area, the fault location is determined by fault area search method, to complete the 66KV transmission line fault location. Experimental results show that the average error rate of transmission line fault location is 2%, and the average output time of positioning results is only 0.38s, the proposed method has higher positioning accuracy and better real-time positioning.

articleTitle: A Prediction Model of Clinical Diagnosis by The Combination of Traditional Chinese and Western Medicine Based on Data Mining
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: To improve the single type of the existing clinical diagnosis and treatment decision support system, this paper proposes an intelligent medical diagnosis model of integrated TCM and Western medicine based on data mining. The scheme mainly inputs the diagnosis data into two subsystems for training and testing, according to the characteristics of the clinical diagnosis support information environment. Firstly, the improved Apriori algorithm is used to mine the TCM diagnosis and treatment data to obtain more perfect diagnosis information; then the BP neural network optimized by GA is adopted to process the real samples to improve the medical diagnosis speed. Finally, a clinical diagnosis prototype system combining the two methods is designed by customs clearance development, which is applied in the specific decision support and achieves good mining effect, and the prediction data is basically consistent with the clinical practice. Therefore, the scheme has been proved to be feasible and helpful to reduce clinical medical errors.

articleTitle: Flight Vehicle Penetration Probability Evaluation against the Missile Intercepting
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: Traditional flight vehicle penetration effect evaluation is based on penetration miss distance. Because of the random distribution of miss distance, the traditional evaluation method brings much evaluation error and the evaluation result can only provide the successful penetration or not but can’t provide the penetration effect parameter caused by the corresponding miss distance. To discover the quantitative relationship between the miss distance and penetration effect , the penetration probability evaluation against the intercepting is researched. Firstly, the kill probability model of single missile is built up. Then the mapping model between the penetration probability and miss distance is created to evaluate the penetration probability corresponding miss distance. Finally, the algorithm performance is simulated by using of typical scenario. The penetration probability evaluation method proposed can be used for all kinds of plane and missile by calculating the penetration probability corresponding miss distance to provide commander accurate data for battle decision-making and it’s important in theory and practice.

articleTitle: The Evaluation of College English Extracurricular Reading Independent Learning Model Based on Big Data
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: In order to better cultivate contemporary college students’ extracurricular English reading ability, improve their ability of independent learning after class, and adapt to the requirements of college English curriculum and teaching reform in the new era, this paper first analyzes the theories and technical support related to big data and the constructed independent learning model of extracurricular English reading based on big data, then implements an experiment by selecting some college students and dividing them into experimental group and control group. The final experimental results show that the independent learning model of English extracurricular reading based on big data helps to cultivate the improvement of students’ comprehensive English application ability, helps to improve students’ English performance, and also provides a new idea for the reform of English course teaching.

articleTitle: An Intelligent Traffic Signal Control Approach Based on WSN Positioning Technology
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: Aiming at the problem of traffic signal control in multi intersection, a system model based on wireless sensor network(WSN) is proposed. According to the characteristics of intelligent transportation system, the hardware structure of sensor node, central control node and upper and lower computer is designed and implemented. According to the original static network model, the vehicle node is added to collect the bus flow information. At the same time, the classical genetic algorithm is introduced to reduce its time complexity, and the adjacent individual pruning strategy is adopted to improve the uniformity of solution distribution. The simulation results show that the system can realize the intelligent control of traffic signal, and the effect is better than the traditional control method, which also shoes good application value.

articleTitle: Detection and analysis of road information based on optical satellite image
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: Using remote sensing image for road information extraction has gradually become a significant part of intelligent highway management and maintenance. The road extraction of reasonable segmentation scale and characteristic elements are studied by applying object-oriented image information extraction method. First of all, the image is enhanced, then the appropriate segmentation and merging threshold value is selected for image segmentation, after that the road information is extracted by making rules according to the characteristic description of the road. It is proved that the object-oriented method can effectively extract the road information from remote sensing images.

articleTitle: Parameters Modeling of Paddy Grain Drying Based on Orthogonal Experiment
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: The existing empirical and semi-empirical models provided strong support for the paddy grain drying process, but the accuracy of the models needed to be improved. In order to improve the accuracy of the model, various parameters in the drying process were comprehensively considered in this paper, including air temperature, air relative humidity, initial moisture content, air velocity and tempering ratio. The orthogonal experiment was carried out and the regression model of drying time, accumulated temperature and germination rate ratio was established in this study. The results of variance analysis showed that the coefficient of determination of drying time model, accumulated temperature model and germination rate ratio model were 0.9835, 0.9776 and 0.5479, respectively. It is proved that the drying time and accumulated temperature model can be applied to actual paddy grain drying.

articleTitle: Image Segmentation of Skin Lesions Based on Attention Mechanism and Deep Convolutional Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: With the increasing fatality rate of melanoma, accurate segmentation of lesion area in skin disease image plays an important role in the diagnosis of skin cancer. Computer-aided diagnosis system can provide objective opinions for the diagnosis and treatment of melanoma. The existing skin disease images are mostly obtained by professional dermoscope instruments, and the judgment of the skin lesion area is mainly from the judgment of professional doctors, but this method will be affected in both efficiency and accuracy. In the feature analysis of image data sets, there are some problems, such as a small number of image labeled samples, large diversity of skin lesion area and no obvious difference between lesion area and background. In order to improve the ability of feature extraction, a neural network with attention mechanism is proposed. The algorithm is based on Mask R-CNN network and channel attention mechanism to improve the importance of acquiring each feature channel and enhance the useful features. Experimental results on data sets containing different degrees of melanoma show that the algorithm can achieve better performance than the traditional Mask R-CNN.

articleTitle: Design of Digital Media Virtual Display Platform Based on Virtual Reality Technology
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: In order to improve the object-oriented and visual presentation ability of the digital media virtual display platform, the virtual reality technology is adopted to design the digital media virtual display platform. In the virtual reality environment, a design method of digital media virtual display platform based on multi-thread fusion scheduling and image fusion processing is proposed. The general structure model of digital media virtual display platform is constructed, the image information transmission channel model of digital media virtual display system platform is constructed by adopting serial VIX bus control technology, the basic entity object of digital media virtual display platform is constructed, and the multi-thread scheduling method is adopted for image fusion information scheduling and digital media control processing of digital media virtual display platform. The visual simulation and image processing model of digital media virtual display are constructed by using the serial channel control model, and the communication design between the system multi-channel serial port and the host computer is carried out. The software development of digital media virtual display platform is realized on MATLAB and VC++ platform. Experimental results show that the visual simulation effect of the digital media virtual display platform is good, which improves the reliability and stability of the digital media virtual display system platform and reduces the error of digital media information transmission.

articleTitle: Multi image cross hybrid encryption method based on combined chaotic system
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: In order to improve the security and encryption efficiency of multi image cross hybrid encryption, a multi image cross hybrid encryption method based on combined chaotic system is proposed. On the basis of chaos theory, the characteristics of Logistic chaotic system and Lorenz chaotic system are analyzed, and Logistic chaotic system and Lorenz chaotic system are combined to form a combined chaotic system. In order to improve the security of multi image encryption, the plaintext image is preprocessed before encryption. The preprocessing process is embedding random number sequence in the plaintext image. Based on the random number embedded image, the combined chaotic system is applied to the multi image cross chaotic encryption method. Experimental results show that the proposed method has high encryption security and high encryption efficiency.

articleTitle: A Multi-person collaborative Simulation System For Circuit Experiment System Base on Virtual Reality
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: The learning of physical circuit experiments has the characteristics of both theory and practice. In order to enhance students' hands-on ability and reduce the difficulty and cost of practical teaching, a virtual reality-based multi-person collaborative circuit 3D virtual experiment simulation system is proposed. We use 3ds max to construct a circuit simulation lab, and use socket technology to realize multi-person online interaction. And use Photon network engine to realize multiplayer linkage. The system includes two main parts, circuit experiment practice and custom experiment, and circuit simulation simulation through 3D interface. The system can use wires to connect the circuit components and display the experimental results in real time through the interface, visually reflecting the impact of different circuit connections and parameter changes on the simulation results, and has the function of students using the equipment library to connect and create circuits independently, so that they can build circuits independently to realize the simulation of innovative experiments.

articleTitle: Experimental study on the gas-particle two-phase flow characteristics in a fluidized bed SCR denitrification reactor
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: A set of fluidized bed SCR flue gas denitrification reactor experimental system was designed based on the denitrification system of a 600MW coal-fired unit, and the gas particles in the fluidized bed SCR flue gas denitrification reactor under different working conditions were measured on this experimental system. The flow characteristics of the two phases were studied. The experimental results are in good agreement with the simulation results. The distribution in the axial direction of the fluidized bed is more uniform, which is more conducive to the full contact between the flue gas and the catalyst.

articleTitle: Flame Image Pyrometry in Combustion Chamber Temperature Field Measurement
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: In order to make up for the defects of traditional temperature measurement methods, CCD cameras are gradually applied to the measurement of temperature fields of high-temperature objects. In this paper, by establishing the furnace flame radiation energy imaging and temperature imaging model, an algorithm for reconstructing the temperature field is proposed, and the feasibility of reconstructing the three-dimensional temperature field of a large furnace chamber is analyzed and demonstrated. On this basis, a breakthrough in real-time visualization and detection technology of the three-dimensional temperature field in the combustion chamber of an aero-engine is realized.

articleTitle: Effect of Air Density on the Fatigue Life of Wind Turbine Blades
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: In order to solve the problem of different wind field air density leading to different fatigue life of wind turbine blades, this paper takes a 2MW blade as the research object. In this research, the load of wind turbine blade under different air density based on the blade unit momentum theory is calculated, then the blade load spectrum is established according to the actual measurement data of a wind field in Hunan Province, and the fatigue life of the blade is calculated using ANSYS and nCode Designlife. The fatigue load and cycle life of the blade at different air densities were also quantified. The results show that the air density is inversely proportional to the fatigue life of the blade. The greater the air density, the greater the fatigue damage. The influence of air density in different regions can be accommodated by optimizing the layered design of blade hazardous areas.

articleTitle: Identification method of fishing vessel operation type based on LightGBM and BiLSTM
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: In order to overcome the problem of fishery resources damage caused by fishermen’s illegal operations during the fishing process, the paper proposes a method for identifying the type of fishing vessel operation based on LightGBM-BiLSTM This method studies the Beidou data of different fishing vessel, extracts the 42-dimensional effective spatiotemporal feature vectors of the fishing vessel operation mode, stitches the pre-recognition results and the original data to complete the time series slice and 3D reconstruction, and enters the LightGBM-BiLSTM model to carry out the operation type of the fishing vessel. Recognition. Experiments were conducted with Beidou data from 2.09 million fishing vessel, and the accuracy, precision, and recall rates of identification were 98.42%, 99.04%, and 97.56%, respectively. The experimental results show that this method can accurately identify the type of fishing vessel operation, and can be used for remote fishing vessel operation type identification and supervision, which proves the feasibility of this method.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of B2C Agricultural Products E-commerce Sales Platform Based on MVC Mode
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: To provide an online platform for agricultural products sales, this paper designs a B2C agricultural products e-commerce sales platform under MVC mode. The platform adopts system controller, communication module, LCD and other components in the access layer to acquire the information generated by products sales platform and store it in DBS according to the data type. Then, through the layered system based on MVC framework and Java Web server, the design of each layer are explained and implemented. The platform test and running results show that the such platform has comprehensive performance advantages in response speed and throughput in the case of multi concurrency.

articleTitle: Intelligent repair method of corrosion defect on rotor surface of fluid machinery
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: In order to solve the problem of low recognition accuracy and repair efficiency of traditional repair methods for rotor surface corrosion defects of fluid machinery, a new intelligent repair method for rotor surface corrosion defects of fluid machinery is proposed in this paper. Firstly, microwave nondestructive testing method is used to accurately identify the corrosion defects on the rotor surface. Based on the recognition results of corrosion defects, the 3D laser model is used to repair the corrosion defects, calculate the area of the corrosion defects to be repaired and predict the lap path in the repair path, so as to complete the intelligent repair of the corrosion defects on the surface of the fluid machinery rotor. The experimental results show that the proposed repair method has better recognition accuracy of corrosion defects than the traditional repair method, and the repair time is greatly shortened. Therefore, it fully shows that the proposed intelligent repair method for surface corrosion defects of fluid machinery rotor has high practical value.

articleTitle: Modeling and Analysis of Water Quality Evaluation
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: In order to protect the water environment of Wulingyuan World Natural Heritage Site and maintain the sustainable development of its tourism industry, this paper analyzes the surface water quality of Wulingyuan World Natural Heritage Site from 2014 to 2018 by using the single pollution index method and fuzzy comprehensive evaluation method. The results showed that: 1) TN, FC, TP and NH3-N exceeded the class I water quality standards by 19.6, 17.5, 12.6 and 2.6 times, respectively, and were the main pollutants in the water of Wulingyuan World Natural Heritage Site. At the same time, the water quality of Wulingyuan World Natural Heritage Site gradually decreased from class II to class V in five years, with a significant downward trend. 2) The water quality changes in Wulingyuan World Natural Heritage Site are related to the tourists' unconsciousness and bad behaviors, the continuous expansion of tourism scale, the cultivation of ornamental fish and the direct discharge behavior of domestic sewage. On the whole, the water quality of Wulingyuan World Natural Heritage Site has declined obviously and the pollution is serious. Moreover, the deterioration of water quality is closely related to tourism.

articleTitle: Multivalued Amplitude Spectrum Generation Method of TDCS in Complex Spectrum Environment
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: In order to overcome the unstable generation of amplitude spectrum and insufficient utilization of interference band in transformed domain communication system (TDCS), a multi-value amplitude spectrum generation method based on energy detection is proposed. Firstly, the channel power spectrum envelope is used to determine the distribution bands and size of noise. Then each band is labeled as an exponential power of its multiple based on the benchmark of the minimum power spectrum, which achieves an adaptive labeling of the whole spectrum. Finally, for different spectral environments, the adjustment factor is introduced into the label spectrum to change the convergence rate of interference suppression according to the spectral conditions. The results show that compared with the optimal single threshold method, this method reduces the bit error rate to less than 0.1 times, increases the spectral occupancy by 20%, and has less computational complexity when the number of sample points of the amplitude spectrum is large. It is suitable for channel environments where there are multiple interference sources in the channel and the frequency band occupancy of the interference is large.

articleTitle: A Video Classification Strategy Based on Content Recognition in English Teaching
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: To enrich the function of foreign language video teaching system based on streaming media technology, this paper introduces content recognition technology based on clustering algorithm. This paper proposes an improved k-means clustering algorithm for video interest permutation and combination to identify videos with high interest of students and realize push management. Then, it introduces the practice and development of video teaching system in English teaching, including MVC design mode, system function and system structure design. The key technologies involved in the system, such as data security, permission allocation, database development and web application, are described in detail, and the implementation methods of each functional module of the system are given. Finally, the specific functional requirements of the teaching system are tested and analyzed from the aspects of registration, login and live video, which proves the feasibility and effectiveness of the scheme.

articleTitle: Fabry-Perot Resonant Cavity Antenna Using Split Resonator Ring
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: In order to overcome the problems of the traditional Fabry-Perot resonator antenna with low gain and beamforming, this paper proposes a metamaterial method that uses an open resonator ring on the partially reflective surface of the upper layer. This method controls the unit’s reflection phase by adjusting the size of the open resonator. The experimental results show that through the combination of the slotting method and the loaded opening resonator method, this method can indeed enable the FP resonator antenna to achieve beam deflection and improve the effect of antenna gain.

articleTitle: Research on Key Technology of Software Intellectual Property Protection
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: Traditional software intellectual property protection technology improves the complexity and anti-attack ability of the program, while it also increases the extra execution cost of the program. Therefore, this paper starts with the obfuscation of program control flow in reverse engineering to provide defense strategies for the protection of software intellectual property rights. Focusing on the parsing and obfuscation of Java byte code, we implement a prototype of code obfuscation system. The scheme improves the class aggregation and class splitting algorithms, discusses the fusion methods of various independent code obfuscation technologies, and provides the description and implementation of other key module algorithms. The experimental analysis shows that the obfuscation transformation scheme in this paper not only gets higher security, but also improves the program performance to a certain extent, which can effectively protect the intellectual property rights of Java software.

articleTitle: Simulation of Heat Transfer Process of Capillary Plane Air Conditioning Based on Numerical Simulation
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: To strengthen the heat transfer process of capillary planar air conditioning system and improve the cooling capacity of air conditioning system, the heat transfer process between capillary planar radiant air conditioning system and outdoor environment is simulated by taking the actual space model as an example. Firstly, the working principle of the capillary plane porous field system is described, and the mathematical model of the system heat transfer analysis is analyzed combined with the mathematical principle. Then, the theory of computational fluid dynamics is applied, the k-ε model is used to make reasonable assumptions, and the numerical calculation problems such as the discretization and coupling solution of the equation are discussed. The model is meshed and the boundary conditions are set. Finally, the heat transfer of the external walls and windows of the capillary plane radiation air conditioning system is analyzed by the software simulation, and the change curve is drawn according to the simulation, which proves the feasibility and effectiveness of the scheme in this paper.

articleTitle: Research on the Key Technology of Intelligent Mine Gas Forecasting Model Based on SVM
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: In view of the shortcoming of the current mine monitoring system only providing the threshold alarm, this paper makes full use of the rich historical data in the database of monitoring system, selects the normal data samples and the abnormal data samples first, respectively models the normal and abnormal samples and then extracts the feature vector of each sample, and finally using the support vector machine to train the feature vector of each sample to get the on-line forecasting model mainly based on mine gas. The simulation results show that support vector machine prediction model can realize the on-line measurement and risk prediction mine gas. It provides intelligent decision guidance for mine managers, and further improves the overall function of mine monitoring.

articleTitle: Architecture Design of Application Oriented Undergraduate Innovation and Entrepreneurship Guidance Service Platform Based on Big Data Technology
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: A large number of homogeneous university innovation and entrepreneurship information platform construction is facing low utilization rate, which cannot support the activities and sustainable development of teachers and students. Therefore, based on the development situation of big data era, this paper establishes an innovation and entrepreneurship guidance service platform based on B/S architecture for the guidance service of innovation and entrepreneurship education system in application-oriented universities. The scheme mainly uses the advanced J2EE environment, and combined with big data to build a new model of innovation and entrepreneurship education system in application-oriented university. We also design and implement the key modules of the system combined with data sharing and Internet technology. The development process involves the storage application of Servlet, JavaBean, JSP, JavaScript and SQL technology. The system operation test results prove the feasibility of the scheme, which can effectively play the role of big data and improve the entrepreneurship rate of college graduates.

articleTitle: Research on Strata Visualization Algorithm Based on Borehole
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: In order to solve the massive geological information visualization and better understand the structure and relationship of information, it can provides better information support for geological exploration and urban construction and informatization. This paper provides a solution of stratum visualization based on borehole. It mainly studies the functions of stratum generation, texture filling, logging curves and contour lines, and systematically studies and improves a variety of algorithms, including DDA straight line generation algorithm, polygon search algorithm, automatic stratum generation algorithm, stratum Color and picture filling algorithm etc. It applies the drilling data of the new campus of Tianjin Tianshi College as the data source, using SQLServer2005 and VC++6.0 as system development platform, and combining MFC, STL and ADO technologies to realize system data encapsulation and access. Finally it realized the automatic generation and color of the stratum, the two-dimensional expression function of geological symbols such as geological information storage and access, texture filling, logging curves, topographic maps and contour lines, It provides a good technical interface and foundation for 3D visualization of geological information.

articleTitle: Fragmented Learning Mode for College Students in Big Data Environment
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: Nowadays, information technology has greatly changed the way people learn. Fragmented learning, as an informal way of learning, has become an important approach to learn new technologies and knowledge. By analyzing the connotation, characteristics, advantages and disadvantages of fragmented learning, this paper proposes a fragmented learning solution for college students in a data environment, which can recommend personalized learning plans for students and also provide decision making for teachers by collecting and analyzing student’s learning data. In this thesis, a mobile application is developed to collect learner-related data, such as time, location, content, and frequency, etc. What’s more, this proposed method is expected to play an important role in guiding the construction of a lifelong learning society.

articleTitle: A Lattice-based approach for Mining Non-Redundant High Utility Association Rules
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: High utility itemsets mining provides more information, which can help manager to make better decisions. However, there are too many redundant high utility itemsets which makes it difficult for users to find useful information in a large set of high utility itemsets. To solve this problem, this paper proposed an approach for mining non-redundant high-utility association rules (NR-HAR) efficiently in both dense and sparse datasets, which make more timely decisions on business strategy. This approach includes two phases: (1) building an extended high utility itemsets Lattice(EHUIL) and identify generator and closed itemsets within this. (2) Proposing an efficient algorithm for mining NR-HAR from the built EHUIL. The new algorithm is based on utility-confidence framework and the lattice structure, obtaining semantic relationships among HUIs. Extracting results from EHUIL, which having closed flag and generator flag, determining to find rules with child nodes to be stopped or continued. We carry out experiments to show the efficiency of the proposed method. The experimental results show that this new approach has a faster runtime on different types of datasets than existing methods, especially in sparse database.

articleTitle: Adaptive High Dimensional Multi Objective Evolutionary Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: To search more Pareto optimal solution set in decision space, this paper uses the non-dominated sorting method in multi-objective optimization problem to perform the research of particle swarm optimization(PSO). A dynamic ring topology and mutation mechanism is proposed to enhance the global search ability of multi-objective PSO algorithm. Based on the random number condition of single particle trajectory convergence, a ring structure is constructed between the subpopulations to improve the local search ability. On the premise of ensuring the diversity of optimal solutions, the stability of the structure among populations is fully considered to ensure the stability of the final algorithm. Finally, through the analysis of experimental data, the effectiveness of improved PSO algorithm in dealing with high-dimensional multi-objective optimization problems is verified, which provides a new idea for dealing with multi-modal and multi-objective optimization problems.

articleTitle: Analysis of storage state and condensation risk of paddy pile based on temperature and humidity field cloud map
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: In order to explore the condensation mechanism of paddy pile, a simulation test was carried out in this study. The research object of this article is stored paddy about 0.2m below the surface of paddy pile, close to the warehouse wall at which it’s easy to occur condensation effected by environmental factor. In this paper, the temperature and relative humidity of different district in paddy pile in different seasons were monitored by integrated temperature and humidity sensors. The datum of stored paddy conditions was detected. Then the cloud map of the temperature field and humidity field of the paddy pile were drawn using MATLAB simulation software to analyze the distribution of temperature and humidity fields of paddy. It showed that there was a ‘hot core’ in the middle of the pile in late spring and early summer. The temperature gradient differences caused micro-airflow formation which had resulted in the internal heat and moisture migration and redistribution. Finally, a high relative humidity zone appeared. Based on the WU (CAE) model, the different states (equilibrium state, saturation state, adsorption state or desorption state) of the risk points in the paddy pile were calculated. If the ambient relative humidity decreases, the desorption state of paddy pile will be in the dominant position. If the ambient relative humidity remains high, the paddy pile will constantly keep absorption, and even reach the saturated state, which become serious hazard to storing paddy. The discovery of these change laws could be helpful to reduce the grain storage loss and to ensure the safety of grain storage.

articleTitle: Research on Evaluation Method of ERP Management System Application Efficiency
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: In order to strengthen the interactive relationship between enterprise management practice and information system, and realize the correct evaluation of enterprise ERP management efficiency, this paper puts forward a scheme of using neural network model to predict the implementation effect of ERP. On the basis of defining the research scope and task of ERP implementation diagnosis model, we adopt BP neural network evaluation method which can ensure the objectivity of diagnosis. Firstly, the enterprise management decomposition and ERP software decomposition scheme are proposed, and the system evaluation index system is established. Then, during the implementation process, GA is used to evaluate the line subsystem, and each system is ranked according to the evaluation score to find the weakest subsystem. Finally, through a specific application example, to evaluate the implementation effect of ERP in a manufacturing industry, it proves that the results are more efficient and practical, which is of great significance to promote the informatization construction of enterprises in China.

articleTitle: An Enterprise Human Resource Allocation Management Model Based on CMMI
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: To improve the human resource management level of enterprises, this paper designs a practical human resource statistics method based on the characteristics of CMMI. We first put forward the hypothesis of capability difference, and on this basis, we establish the human resource allocation model in the process of CMMI implementation, and provide corresponding solutions. In case analysis, linear programming, regression analysis, AHP are used to quantify the information or data obtained, to overcome the limitation of traditional knowledge and the uncertainty of standard implementation result, which finally verifies the effectiveness and practicability of our model.

articleTitle: Application Analysis of BIM Technology in Project Management
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: In order to achieve the integration of design and construction, reduce engineering changes, save project costs and other performance goals, this paper analyzes the application of BIM technology in engineering projects through combining theory with practice. We systematically analyzed the process of BIM application in large-scale engineering projects, and realized the information unification of building life cycle management. Then the application points of BIM Technology in construction project are analyzed, and the key technologies needed for system implementation are described in detail. Finally, taking a construction project management process as a case to simulate, the specific measures of project modeling process, collision inspection and construction simulation process are proposed. The test and analysis results confirm the rationality and advantages of BIM Technology for project management and construction guidance.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Hotel Reservation Management Platform Based on SOA Framework
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: To solve the problems of hotel information island, complex network reservation process and inconvenient management, this paper analyzes and studies the hotel business management, and designs an extreme reservation management platform of face-to-face service combined with SOA framework and Webservice system. The system adopts unified channel entrance to form centralized management and distributed operation. Base on the B/S architecture, we adopt the development framework SSH and front-end development technology (jQuery, bootstrap, etc.), combined with the lightweight database Mysql, to achieve seamless heterogeneous platform. At the same time, the compatibility of mobile platform is also considered, and the specific module design and implementation method are provided. Finally, the test results of the system operation show that such scheme can process and analyze the customer booking data in time, provide data basis for the management decision analysis, and improve the satisfaction of customers and merchants.

articleTitle: A Clothing Design Method and System Implementation Based on Virtual Measurement of Human Body Shape
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: Existing virtual fitting system is not real enough and has poor interactive operation ability. In view of the shortcomings of these fitting systems, this paper proposes the size measurement method based on human image and the construction method of personalized virtual human model. The scheme is based on Kinect somatosensory measurement technology to obtain human depth information and bone data. At the same time, it analyzes the principle of bone animation and the characteristics of mainstream bone skinning algorithm, and completes the production of human model and animation by using 3dsmax modeling software. On this basis, the fitting surface and the clothing mesh model surface are divided into corresponding regions to improve the reality of the wearing effect. Finally, through the system fitting effect test, it shows that the system has a good clothing matching effect, which can meet the basic requirements of users' daily fitting.

articleTitle: Balanced allocation system of physical education resources based on SOA Architecture
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: In order to solve the problem of poor resource mining accuracy and allocation balance in the traditional balanced allocation system of physical education resources, this paper proposes a new balanced allocation system of physical education resources based on SOA architecture. In the SOA architecture system, the overall architecture of the system is designed. In the hardware part of the system, the identity authentication module, the network structure model of educational resources, and the resource balanced configuration module are designed to meet the functional requirements of the system. In the software part of the system, particle swarm optimization algorithm is used to achieve the balanced allocation of physical education resources. The experimental results show that, compared with the traditional system, the designed system has higher mining accuracy and stronger resource allocation balance.

articleTitle: Research on Intelligent Image Scrambling Transform Encryption Algorithm Based on Big Data Analysis
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: In order to improve the encryption ability of scrambling transformation of high-resolution knowledge map remote sensing image, a scrambling transformation encryption model of high-resolution knowledge map remote sensing image based on big data analysis and multi feature fusion is proposed. The edge pixel feature analysis model of high-resolution knowledge map remote sensing image is constructed. The edge pixel feature distributed reorganization method is used to realize the pixel structure reorganization. The image is processed by multispectral parameter big data fusion and chaos quantization linear feature analysis. The image encryption key feature analysis is realized by using the combination control method of shallow feature map. The personalized features extracted from image are identified by using intelligent image scrambling transform encryption algorithm, and the multilevel feature analysis model of image scrambling transform encryption is established. The simulation results show that the method has high adaptability and good scrambling performance, and improves the ability of fusion encryption and feature recognition of high-resolution knowledge map remote sensing image.

articleTitle: Research on Hybrid Intelligent Algorithm for Comprehensive Evaluation of Aviation Logistics Performance
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: To evaluate the performance of air logistics service providers and manage them comprehensively, and realize the purpose of high efficiency of the whole logistics activities, this paper proposes a hybrid intelligent algorithm for the evaluation of air logistics service providers for aviation enterprises by discussing the current situation and existing problems of the evaluation of air logistics service providers of a freight company. Based on determining the weights of several key factors evaluation indexes of aviation logistics enterprises, and aiming at the shortcomings of BP neural network in randomly initial weights and thresholds, the global search function of genetic algorithm is used to assign the optimal weights and thresholds of BP neural network. The calculated performance score is taken into BP neural network as a sample for correction to eliminate subjective factors. In the experimental part, the trained neural network model is used for formal performance evaluation. The results show that the performance evaluation method based on improved genetic algorithm has the characteristics of high speed and high accuracy, which is of great significance for the establishment of a scientific and effective aviation performance evaluation system.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Internet Plus State-owned Enterprise Information Management System
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: In order to solve the problem of information isolation in the internal network of enterprise, this paper designs and implements a basic framework of enterprise information management system under the background of Internet Plus. The main development language of the system is J2EE. The project follows the classic MVC three-tier architecture mode and focus on the automatic generation of code. In the development process of the key functional modules, SOA architecture, SSH and DAO, XML, MySQL database technology are applied to complete the test and implementation of the whole system. The results show that the web-based information service realizes the data communication between different subsystems of the enterprise, and improves the efficiency, controllability and overall information level of the enterprise operation.

articleTitle: Project Risk Assessment Model Based on Entropy Theory
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: In the past, the risk assessment of construction projects focused on the static qualitative research, and the weight selection was subjective. To make up for the influence of such aspect on the effect of project risk assessment, this paper adopts the systematic and dynamic risk assessment and analysis method based on the theory of information entropy weight. It combines the quantification of information with probability analysis, and determines the weight of each index of the risk matrix, to make risk decision for the engineering project. Finally, through the example analysis, the information entropy is implemented on the analysis and evaluation of the actual project risk factors, which proves that the scheme can reduce the risk cost and maximize the enterprise benefit.

articleTitle: Construction of Urban Rainstorm & Flood Model and Simulation of Drainage Capacity of Pipeline Network Based on GIS
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: In order to overcome the unreasonable problems existing in the current drainage network planning and design, this paper puts forward the spatial analysis method of geographic information technology, which extracts the key parameters of the rainwater management model (SWMM), and converts the parameters stored in ShapeFile format into the files that conform to the model specifications, so as to construct the drainage network model of the research area based on GIS. Using the model simulation software to further improve the model parameters, six Chicago rainfall hydrographs are synthesized. The design return period p of rainstorm is 0.25A, 0.5A, la, 2a, 5A and 10A respectively, and the rainfall peak coefficient r is 0.4. The pipe network models under these six rainfall scenarios are simulated, so as to statistically analyze the drainage capacity of the pipe network under these different scenarios. The experimental results show that this method can effectively detect the rationality of drainage network planning and design.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Human Computer Interaction Platform for Online Ideological and Political Education under The Background of Mobile Learning
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: To make human-computer interaction technology get better interactive experience in e-learning, this paper designs a mobile teaching interactive platform for ideological and political education courses. In order to realize the classroom like course, we use teaching interaction, resource sharing, real-time communication and other modules to show more interactive choices. The key technologies of whiteboard and projection interaction design, screen sharing are also used to solve the problem of graphic logic which is difficult to be communicated. Finally, the mobile end of interactive teaching system based on Android operating system is implemented, and the function and performance of the system are tested. The test results show that the system can meet the needs of mobile online teaching of network ideological and political education, optimize the transmission quality and platform architecture of network teaching, and provide better use experience for teachers and students.

articleTitle: Error Correcting System for Volleyball Smashing Based on Machine Vision
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: In order to overcome the problem of low accuracy of motion detection and error correction in traditional volleyball smashing technology action correction system, a volleyball smashing technology action correction system based on machine vision is proposed and designed. The hardware part of the system, designs the motion image detection module of Volleyball Smash technology, completes the image detection with the support of the principle of image depth collection; the hardware part also includes the motion feature recognition module to extract the features of the smash technology action. System software part, based on the convolution neural network in machine vision, extracts the error correction features of volleyball smashing technology action image to complete the error correction of volleyball smashing technology action. The experimental results show that, compared with the traditional error correction system, the designed motion correction system of Volleyball Smash technology has higher accuracy of motion detection and error correction, and higher practical application value.

articleTitle: Research on Tracking Algorithm of Turning Maneuvering Target
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: With the rapid development of science and technology, various application systems have put forward increasingly complex requirements for the development of theories. Therefore, the traditional theory and techniques of maneuvering target tracking face new challenges. In order to overcome the problems of low positioning accuracy and long time consuming in traditional maneuvering target tracking. In view of the goal of turning movement model, this paper firstly summarizes the four models of turning maneuver with Cartesian coordinate system expansion model, great dimensional motor model, dynamics constraint, and turning motor turning center model turning, then compares the four turning models, and finally draws conclusions and suggestions through simulation.

articleTitle: The Design and Implementation of an Oscillator Chip with Negative Resistance
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: Conventional chips directly use resistors as loads, which consume a lot of power and resistors occupy a large area. Aiming at the shortcomings of the traditional Pierce oscillator, this paper designs a low power consumption and high stability crystal oscillator chip based on 0.35m CMOS technology, and improves the circuit structure of the oscillator by analyzing the method of negative resistance oscillation principle. The designed crystal oscillator chip consists of an oscillation circuit, a chip buffer circuit, a frequency divider circuit and an output driver circuit. The simulation results show that when the crystal oscillator frequency is 15.9MHZ, the circuit oscillates within 0.6ms, the output waveform is very stable, the maximum range of the voltage controlled oscillator is ±181ppm, and the power consumption of the oscillation circuit is as low as 3.2mW.

articleTitle: Characteristics Analysis of VE Network
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: The characterization of virtual enterprises can facilitate companies to make full use of information technology to meet challenges such as market globalization and technological innovation. In this paper, virtual enterprises are shaped into a complex network and their characteristics are analyzed in detail. Firstly, the (N, E, W) model of virtual enterprise network is established by using complex shape theory. Secondly, the standard metrics for evaluating the performance of the virtual enterprise network are defined from both node and edge perspectives. The simulation results show the degree distribution of the VE1 network. Besides, the approach used in this paper provides a comprehensive picture of the characterization of virtual enterprise networks.

articleTitle: Mobile Augmented Reality Technology in Museum Cultural and Creative Products Design
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: To enrich the design of cultural and creative products derived from museums, this paper discusses the key technologies of mobile enhancement technology in cultural and creative products. During the design process, we adopt visual technology to extract the features of product modeling. Then the virtual 3D model or animation is loaded under the unity3d platform to complete the construction of virtual background. Finally, the interactive application of augmented reality is completed by combining the augmented reality plug-in Vuforia SDK. The experiment shows that our scheme can realize the superposition and mixed rendering of virtual environment and real scene, which can provide users with rich visual experience.

articleTitle: Research on Fault Location of Transmission Line Based on Wide Area Synchronous Measurement Technology
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: In order to solve the problems of low precision and long time of traditional transmission line fault region localization method, this paper proposes a transmission line fault region localization method based on wide area synchronous measurement technology. Set up a wide area synchronous measurement system and use the system to collect transmission line information. Based on the collected information, the transmission line state description matrix is constructed, and the diagonal elements in the state description matrix are modified according to the measurement points.
