After the modification, all the information is integrated to obtain the location results of the fault area. Experimental results show that the accuracy of fault location of transmission line is always maintained above 93%, and the average time of location is 0.46s, the practical application effect is good.

articleTitle: Simulation analysis on Dynamic Performance of Permanent Magnet Synchronous Spindle using MATLAB
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: To improve the stability of the traditional PMSM spindle under PI controller, this paper adopts the active disturbance rejection control technology combined with parameter tuning to achieve the linear combination control effect. Based on the analysis of PMSS mathematical model and system vector control strategy, the dynamic response process of PMSS is completed through the adjustment strategy of TD, ESO and NLSEF. Then, the discrete control algorithm is established and transplanted to the system, and the effectiveness of the scheme is tested by Matlab/Simulink. The experimental results show that the system has excellent dynamic performance, with timely parameter adjustment and easy operation when using ADRC control strategy, which can achieve the expectation of permanent magnet synchronous motor direct torque control.

articleTitle: Multi dimensional model construction of enterprise performance evaluation system based on EVA Perspective
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: In order to overcome the problems of high evaluation accuracy and efficiency in traditional multi-dimensional model of enterprise performance evaluation system, this paper proposes a multi-dimensional model of enterprise performance evaluation system based on EVA perspective. The decision tree model is constructed, and the decision tree algorithm is used to mine the enterprise performance data. Based on the results of data mining, this paper calculates and analyzes the multi-dimensional evaluation index of enterprise performance according to EVA evaluation index. According to the calculation results of different evaluation indexes, the multidimensional model of enterprise performance evaluation system is constructed. The experimental results show that, compared with the traditional evaluation model, this model has higher evaluation accuracy and efficiency.

articleTitle: Customer Satisfaction Mining of Tourism Website Based on Social Networking Platform: A Case Study of Guizhou Industrial Heritage Tourism Route
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: At present, there is a lack of in-depth quantitative analysis and research results on the tourist satisfaction of tourism routes. In order to make up for the vacancy in such research field, this paper takes the satisfaction mining of Guizhou industrial heritage routes as an example, and performs relevant research on the interaction with customers and emotional analysis based on social networking platform. First, we establish a theoretical model that affects the intention of sustainable use of the website, and through the expert scoring method to weight the indicators, and sort out the evaluation system of customer satisfaction of tourism website. Then, by analytic hierarchy process, it is combined with empirical analysis to verify the research model and hypotheses, calculate the comprehensive weight of each index, and use the structural equation model to test the hypothesis model of the impact of tourism website interaction on customers and satisfaction. Finally, it is proved to provide personalized and differentiated services and precision marketing.

articleTitle: Urban Public Art Space Planning Method Based on Big Data
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: In order to solve the problems of long planning time, high cost and low satisfaction of traditional urban spatial planning methods, this paper proposes a new urban public art space planning method based on big data. The method of combining web crawler technology and questionnaire survey is used to obtain the data of urban public art space, and the K-means clustering method is used to cluster the collected data, and the distributed storage structure model of urban public art space data is designed to facilitate the subsequent data analysis and processing. Taking the community square as the research object, the spatial scale, pavement, greening and public facilities of the community square are planned based on the obtained data. The experimental results show that the urban public art space planning method proposed in this paper has the advantages of short time consuming, low cost, high satisfaction and better practical application effect.

articleTitle: In depth design of prefabricated building column base node based on BIM Technology
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: In order to solve the problems of low precision of model construction and design in the traditional design method of prefabricated building column base node, this paper proposes a BIM based design method of prefabricated building column base node. This paper analyzes the structural form of prefabricated building column base, and uses BIM Technology to build the node model of building column base. The moment bearing capacity, shear value, shear bearing capacity and ultimate bearing capacity of column base joints are calculated to complete the detailed design of prefabricated building column base joints. The experimental results show that, compared with the traditional in-depth design method of column base joints, the accuracy of model construction and column base joint design of this method always maintain a high level.

articleTitle: Transformation System of two Similar Syntax Programs Based on the Compiler Principle
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: In order to overcome the manpower and time problems of two types of syntactically similar program conversion systems, this paper proposes an automatic conversion system for two types of syntactically similar programs based on the compilation principle. The method is divided into three stages: lexical analysis, syntactic analysis and semantic analysis. The lexical analysis scans the source program character by character from left to right and generates a sequence of words for syntactic analysis. Syntactic analysis further groups the symbols of the source program to generate a syntax tree representing the structure of the source program. Semantic analysis traverses the syntax tree to find the rule base for implementing the source program. Finally the syntax tree is traversed to generate the target program. In creating the syntax tree, the composition mode is used, while in traversing the syntax tree, the visitor mode is used. The experimental results show that these two methods can reduce the time of manual conversion.

articleTitle: An Intelligent Photoelectric Detection Approach Based on Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: Photoelectric detection system will be affected by a variety of noise and environmental temperature changes and produce certain errors. To realize the function of error compensation and improve the detection accuracy, an adaptive neural network detection algorithm based on photoelectric detection is established. Aiming at the defects of neural network, such as easily falling into local minimum, slow training speed and poor generalization ability, the local optimization ability of PSO is applied to improve and optimize the learning factor of neural network. The simulation results show that compared with the traditional algorithm, the improved scheme is easier to be implemented and it has faster convergence speed. In the practical application of photoelectric detection principle test box, the nonlinear error caused by temperature change in the illumination detection system can be effectively compensated, and the prediction accuracy can be also improved.

articleTitle: Performance of OFDM system receiver Based on Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: In order to explore the performance of deep learning in wireless communication receivers, a neural network-based method is proposed to realize the functions of OFDM receivers. This method is to directly reduce the noise and restore the transmitted symbols, and does not add the existing channel estimation function network module. Specifically, the mathematical calculation function of Discrete Fourier Transform (DFT) and the training of OFDM signal samples are used to reduce the ser error rate (SER) through the Convolutional Neural Network(CNN). In addition, The robustness of this method is proved by data sets under different modulation modes and different SNR conditions. This article introduces the preliminary research results of OFDM receivers. The experimental results of the simulation in this article show that the method we propose is better than the SER of OFDM receiver based on traditional linear least squares (LS) channel estimation, which drop by 1.6% ~ 6.7% in the conditions of different SNRs and modulation modes.

articleTitle: Identifying Influential Spreaders by Spring Model
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: In order to identify influential spreaders precisely, two new methods of identifying influential spreaders based on the spring model are proposed. Our methods consider two nodes i and j as well as the shortest path between them as a spring, meanwhile, the product of the SLC values of nodes i and j is viewed as the stiffness factor, the difference between network diameter and the shortest path length between two nodes is deemed as the deformation quantity. Using the SIR model to obtain the average spreading scope of each node, evaluated by Kendall’s Tau (τ), the simulation results on fourteen real networks show that the SM+ method and the LSM+ method outperform ten other classical or novel methods, especially, the LSM+ method performs best on eight networks out of the picked fourteen networks.

articleTitle: Research on MAC Protocol Based on Mine Wireless Sensor Network
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: Aiming at a series of problems such as the fixed network structure and the fragile communication lines of the existing mine monitoring system, a new type of mine monitoring and emergency communication network has been constructed. When the wired communication is interrupted, the system wakes up some WSN nodes, and the WSN network quickly forms the Etherent-WSN-Etherent architecture. The paper designs a low energy consumption MAC (LEC-MAC) protocol based on asymmetric Quorum system. This protocol has data frames with priority flags, divides the network into multiple clusters, and adopts a new wake-up mechanism to realize automatic switching of different working modes. The simulation results show that compared with the traditional DCF protocol, our proposed algorithm reduces energy consumption and improves network throughput to meet system requirements.

articleTitle: Research on the Improved Method of UDT Protocal
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: In order to overcome the problem of the low rate of high-performance data transmission protocol UDT in China Telecom network transmission, this paper proposes an improved method. Based on the verification of the data transmission rate of UDT protocol in China Telecom network, the paper proposes The SACK mechanism is used to cope with the problem of repeatedly sending data packets in the fast retransmission mechanism. In the slow start phase of the congestion control link, it solves the problem of speed reduction and misjudgment caused by packet loss. This method adds a small amount of control packet information. The data transmission rate of the improved UDT protocol between the three cities has been significantly improved.

articleTitle: Friction Simulation Analysis of Finger Seal with Different Surfaces Texture
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: As a kind of flexible seal, finger seal has the advantages of low leakage rate and long life, and is widely used in aero-engine, automobile engine and other sealing fields. Surface texture is a new technology to apply non-smooth surfaces to the frictional subsets of relatively moving mechanical parts to improve the tribological performance. In this paper, finite element analysis software ABAQUS is used to simulate the friction between fingertip seals and rotors with different surface textures. The results show that among several micro-slot surface textures, the equivalent stress value of the herringbone groove is relatively low (5.78 MPa), that of vertical micro-slot is large (20.04 MPa), and that of transverse micro-slot is the largest (23.72 MPa); among several micro-hole surface textures, the equivalent force values of triangular and hexagonal are low (about 10 MPa), and that of circular micro-hole texture is relatively large (17.14 MPa), and the elliptical microporous texture has the largest equivalent stress value (21.04 MPa). The higher the equivalent stress value, the more severe the wear. In the design of the fingertip seal surface texture, the surface textures with the smaller equivalent stress value should be selected first.

articleTitle: Application of Mathematical Statistical Analysis in Neural Network Model Optimization
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: In order to solve the problem of uneven distribution of initial population caused by symbol coding in genetic neural network, this paper starts from the working principle of neural network and analyzes the influence of excitation function and system parameters on the output results by using mathematical statistics method. Then a two-stage combinatorial genetic algorithm optimization model is proposed to find the optimal combination of S-type function and RBF function in the network, so that the unconventional nodes can be adjusted in the process of back propagation. Through the simulation test, it is proved that the scheme makes full use of the nonlinear characteristics of various excitation functions, which is conducive to improving the training speed of BP neural network and the convergence speed and prediction accuracy of the model.

articleTitle: Elastic plastic analysis of Expressway Slope Stability Based on finite element analysis
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: In order to improve the stability of expressway slope, an elastic-plastic analysis method based on finite element analysis is proposed. The limit equilibrium method is used to calculate the safety factor of slope. According to the calculation results, the sliding surface of the slope is determined. Based on the determined slope sliding surface, the finite element method is used to complete the finite element simulation of sliding surface, and the discrete finite element matrix is constructed to complete the elastic-plastic analysis of expressway slope stability. Experimental results show that, compared with traditional research methods, the proposed method can extract slope safety factor more accurately and improve the efficiency of analysis.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of A Mobile Learning Resource Sharing System for Ideological and Political Education
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: To solve the problem of storage and transmission of mobile learning resources for ideological and political courses, this paper analyzes the characteristics and current situation of the construction of mobile learning resources, and designs and develops a set of mobile teaching resource sharing system based on open source Android technology and C/S architecture. The system adopts mature ASP.net with MySQL technology solution for development. We also introduce HTML5 audio and video technology to form a knowledge map, and establish the mobile database model based on Agent. After the practical application in the teaching test of Ideological and political course, the system runs well, which can meet the students' personalized and fragmented learning needs, and effectively complete the construction of the interaction process between teachers and students.

articleTitle: Implementation of Construction Project Supervision System Based on BIM
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: Aiming at the actual demand of BIM application in project management, this paper proposes an overall implementation scheme of BIM project supervision system based on cloud platform. Combined with the demand analysis of BIM Technology in engineering management and control in practical work, this paper focuses on the analysis and improvement of the progress management and early warning of engineering project, as well as the supervision and audit function, and provides the implementation method of corresponding modules. Then the 4D construction management system and project integrated management framework are established by visualization technology, and the application effect of the improved scheme is tested by an example in the actual project. The test results show that the system improves the efficiency of construction project schedule management and the degree of data sharing, and provides a new technical method and software system for the application of BIM in project management

articleTitle: Research on open channel irrigation decision system under the background of smart agriculture
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: In order to overcome the problems existing in the existing farmland irrigation control system, such as short control distance, more manpower, no visual information, lack of upper decision-making system and so on, this paper proposes a method of adding network decision-making and information acquisition function on the basis of the original farmland control system. This method can not only easily control multiple gates at the same time, but also realize water flow monitoring It has high controllable resolution and precise control, which makes the original single intelligent control device have Internet control ability. It is not only convenient for farmers to use, but also provides intuitive information basis, and provides data analysis basis for the optimization and promotion of the later stage of the research. The experimental results show that the farmland open channel irrigation decision-making system can be applied in a wide area, can easily realize remote control, no distance limit, the detection device is safe to use, easy to install, and has a high degree of intelligence, which provides convenience for agricultural production and management, and further improves the agricultural production efficiency.

articleTitle: A Prediction System for the Distribution of Epidemic Patients and Asymptomatic Infected Persons Based on Big Data Technology
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: In order to analyse and overcome the enormous impact of coronaviruses on people around the world, this paper presents a predictive model for epidemic and asymptomatic patients based on big data techniques. The prediction model chooses a sampling method to optimise the prediction of the main factor of the prevalent order of asymptomatic patients. Based on this, the prediction model is also able to summarise the current epidemiological problems facing the world’s population and generate a prediction report and a recommendation report. The results of the study show that the prediction model can efficiently and scientifically address the quantitative conditions that define epidemics and pandemics and can accurately predict the distribution of asymptomatic patients, which can help medical professionals to better confront and address epidemic problems.

articleTitle: Research on Students' Physical Health Evaluation Method Based on Data Mining
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: To solve the problems of high cost and difficult maintenance of traditional health evaluation methods, this paper uses data mining technology to realize the data analysis in the medical health management system. Before classification, data preprocessing such as data cleaning and data reduction is performed on the database. The vacancy data is processed, and continuous value attributes are discretized. Then an analysis system for college students' physical health data monitoring is proposed. Using the development mode of B/S and the development framework of SSH, the functional modules of the system are designed and described. In the experimental test part, Apriori algorithm based on matrix is used to find the potential relationship between the dimensions of College Students' physical health, from which the classification rules of students' health problems are determined. Finally, it is verified by the data of the test library. The results show that the system can be used normally in the network environment and make the evaluation decision with practical reference value.

articleTitle: Framework Design of Talent Evaluation and Selection System in Colleges and Universities
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: In order to overcome the limitations of the university talent evaluation and selection system and to optimise the existing university talent evaluation and selection system this paper proposes a novel framework design for a university talent evaluation and selection system. The design solution is able to incorporate advanced science and technology, uses the PHP language and adopts a B/S framework as the architecture. In addition, the design solution adds new technical tools such as responsive layout and ThikPHP architecture. On top of this, the design solution also meets the needs of university teachers and students in several dimensions, such as business requirements and functional requirements. The experimental structure shows that the design is advanced and can effectively improve the objectivity of talent evaluation results and the scientific nature of talent selection in universities.

articleTitle: Influence Analysis on Dynamic Characteristics of Motorized Spindle Based on Pseudo Dynamics
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: To ensure the machining accuracy and safety of the machine tool, and improve the performance of the spindle system, it is necessary to analyze the dynamic characteristics of the motorized spindle and its influencing factors. In this paper, based on the Hertz pseudo dynamic analysis theory, the design principle, finite element analysis and dynamic modeling of motorized spindle are discussed respectively, taking the high-speed and high-power motorized spindle as the research object. Then, the dynamic characteristics of the motorized spindle system caused by high speed are combined with the stability analysis of the tool structure. The dynamic performance of motorized spindle with different preload and front bearing position is calculated by simulation analysis, and the influence law of the above factors on the dynamic characteristics of motorized spindle can be acquired, which also shows the better performance of our method.

articleTitle: Research on Fiber Bragg Grating Sensing Technology Based on Microwave Photon Demodulation
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: Traditional demodulation technology of optical fiber sensor has the disadvantages of low precision, slow speed and poor stability. In order to solve this problem, this paper analyzes the principle of fiber grating microwave photonic filter used in wavelength demodulation, and proposes an optimized sensor demodulation system of wave photonic filter. Microwave electronic demodulators are designed and fabricated by equivalent phase shift (EPS) technology, and they are used in microwave photonic system structure. Then, the temperature transverse stress can be measured simultaneously by demodulating the frequency response parameters of the single pass band filter, and the wavelength shift can be obtained by monitoring the strength of a fixed frequency RF signal. Because no additional temperature compensation measures are needed, this scheme is suitable for the application of stress sensing, and stable demodulation effect is obtained in the simulation experiment.

articleTitle: Design of Tram Communication Transceiver Based on FSK Modulation
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: In order to ensure safe and reliable data communication between modern trams and ground control equipment using wireless induction, this paper designs a communication transceiver between tram and ground based on FSK modulation technology. The hardware design of the transceiver adopts the AVR microcontroller AT90CAN128 with CAN controller as the microcontroller, and the ST7540 chip with FSK carrier signal modulation and demodulation to complete the signal adjustment and demodulation. The microcontroller and the modern chip use serial communication. Separate transmitting and receiving circuits complete the signal filtering and amplification functions, the transceiver uses CAN bus to achieve communication with the vehicle bus, and uses the on-board antenna to complete the inductive communication with the ground control equipment. Experiments show that the design has simple structure, high integration, low power consumption, stable operation, can effectively filter out noise signals, realize the modulation and demodulation of the carrier signal, and the communication function with the vehicle bus and the vehicle transceiver antenna.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Big Data Multimedia Fusion Platform Based on Cloud Computing
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: Through the practice of cloud architecture platform construction, we try to establish a media convergence oriented and Internet oriented cloud technology system. In this paper, the technical architecture, implementation functions and technical points of the integrated media platform are discussed in detail. Using the systematic design concept, the interconnection problem of various manufacturers’ equipment is solved based on the MOS protocol and SSH technology framework, and the automatic control between systems is also realized, as well as the efficient and stable interconnection and automatic control between the devices. The platform running test analysis shows that the scheme significantly enhances the compatibility and reliability of radio and television system, which provides professional system, technology, equipment and service guarantee for solving the timeliness problem of news report.

articleTitle: Monthly Precipitation Forecast of Jiulong River Basin Based on Association Rule Analysis
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: In order to overcome the problems of low accuracy on medium and long term precipitation forecast, a new method based on association rule analysis is proposed under the background of the development and wide application of data mining approach. In this paper, Jiulong River of Yalong River Basin is selected as the research object, and the classical association rule analysis method is used to carry out the research on monthly precipitation forecast. Based on the analysis of 1981-2010 monthly precipitation data, the association rules of precipitation in adjacent two months are obtained, and the accuracy of association rules is tested by monthly rainfall data measured from 2011 to 2014, of which the accuracy is 77.03%. The results show that the monthly precipitation forecast method based on association rule analysis can make good use of historical precipitation information, which can also mine the internal correlation of monthly precipitation and have high forecast accuracy. Furthermore, it provides reference for the medium and long term precipitation forecast of Jiulong River, and has good reference value.

articleTitle: Research on Medical CT Image Data Analyses
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: This paper mainly analyzes the image data of multiple lesions. Analyses were conducted on the raw data such as the frequency statistics of lesions type, the distribution of lesion size, and the age distribution of patients. The analysis data mainly include lesion diameters pixel, coarse lesion type, patient age. Based on this foundation, silhouette coefficient and sum of the squared errors (SSE) are adopted to analysis the optimal K value for anchor boxes cluster. Through the analysis of medical image data, it can provide the foundation for predicting the growth of lesions. It can also be used to classify the lesions, and guide the development of general lesion detector based on database in the next work. This work can help doctors to make clinical diagnosis more comprehensively and improve the efficiency of clinical diagnosis.

articleTitle: Research on Application of AODV Protocol in Mine Wireless Ad-Hoc Network
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: In order to better apply the AODV routing protocol to the mine wireless ad-hoc network, this thesis proposes an improved routing algorithm. Based on the AODV routing protocol choosing the minimum hops path as the routing path, the algorithm adds the consideration of node congestion and residual energy, and designs a new hops count method. This method divides different degrees of node congestion and energy consumption into different levels and determines hops according to different levels. The simulation results show that N-AODV protocol has excellent performance close to AODV protocol and can meet the requirements of mine wireless ad- hoc network.

articleTitle: Feasibility Analysis on The Space Syntax of Library Interior Architectural Space Design
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: To verify the value of space syntax theory in the analysis of the internal space of building, this paper takes a large library as an example, discusses and analyzes the internal space of the built public library building by using space syntax, tests the design of the public library unit which meets the functional requirements, and improves the utilization rate of library space through collaborative research. We focus on the evaluation of the use efficiency of library building space, and through tracking observation, questionnaire survey and other methods, to further analyze and compare the user's behavior and feelings. By the quantitative analysis of space syntax and the comparison of its usage, it is found that the results of quantitative analysis of space syntax are highly consistent with the survey results, and it is consistent with the actual use feelings of teachers and students in the building. It also shows that the space quantitative analysis method based on space syntax theory is feasible for the analysis of existing building space, and the analysis results have high reference value.

articleTitle: The THFC Scheme for compactly committing AEAD
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: In order to overcome some disadvantages of the Encryptment scheme, that is, its hidden compression function should be a secure pseudo-random function to resist relevant key attacks: for key K, the adversary can arbitrarily select X and inquire K⊕X. Therefore, the new scheme of adding tweakable block cipher (TBC) in the paper makes it more resistant to related key attack. Because the attacker cannot directly select the value of the tweak in the base TBC. This method is improved on the HFC Encryptment scheme, and a new scheme is formed by adding the TBC into the compression function, which is called tweak-hash-function-chaining (THFC). It follows the HFC scheme and uses the Merkle-Damgård hash function. It then uses commit encryption and PRF (CEP) to transform the Encryptment scheme to compactly committing authenticated encryption with associated data (ccAEAD) to make it more robust against related key attacks. In addition, DM-AES is used to instantiate the compression function in ccAEAD scheme. While HFCs instantiated using DM-AES will perform very well on systems using AES-NI, they are not as fast as AES-GCM or OCB due to the need to re-key each block. Therefore, Deoxys-BC was selected to instantiate TBC in this paper to verify the ccAEAD scheme using THFC. Compared with Deoxys-I and Deoxys-II under the same conditions, the experimental data show that the performance of ccAEAD-128-128 is faster than that of the optimal Deoxys-I-128-128 after 512 bytes.

articleTitle: Research on Object Location Method of Inspection Robot Based on Machine Vision
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: The inspection space environment of indoor inspection robot in substation is complex and changeable. To acquire autonomous positioning and navigation of inspection robot in substation, which makes it difficult for indoor inspection robot to locate and identify images, this paper proposes a visual positioning method to solve the problem. The realization process of inspection robot vision navigation is to use the wireless detection RFID tag to roughly locate the robot, and use the target image information extracted by a camera to perform ranging, and judge the forward direction of the robot through image processing and pattern recognition. Finally, according to the information stored in the RFID tag, the task type of the robot in a certain position in the substation is determined and executed. The experiment runs in the actual substation environment, and the control algorithm can quickly complete the correction of the deviation from the predetermined track position. At the same time, it shows the characteristics of fast path recognition, accurate discrimination, with flexibility and portability.

articleTitle: Intelligent Analysis of The Causes for China’s Regional Economic Growth Based on FCA
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: In order to study the imbalance and difference of its development comprehensively and dynamically, and acquire more correct analysis results, this paper establishes the application model of clustering analysis method based on data mining in regional economic research. According to the design principle of evaluation index, taking 13 cities in Guangdong Province as samples, we propose a practical regional evaluation index system. FCA is used as the compression representation of frequent mode to perform intelligent comprehensive evaluation on the cities in economic zone. The size of the problem can be reduced by dividing the search space. In the case study, the macro-economic indicators and data of the Regional Economic Yearbook are combined, and the key factors affecting the regional economy are found out by using Polyalyst and MATLAB. The final analysis and statistical results show that the clustering results based on the level of regional economic development are effective and can provide quantitative basis for analyzing the development status and characteristics of regional economy in China.

articleTitle: Study on numerical simulation method of pollutant diffusion law of building decoration materials
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: In order to improve the accuracy and efficiency of numerical simulation of pollutant diffusion law of building decoration materials, a new numerical simulation method of pollutant diffusion law of building decoration materials is proposed. According to the indoor diffusion characteristics of pollutants in building decoration materials, the micro element continuity equation, gas flow rate change rate, energy conservation equation, turbulence energy and diffusion energy consumption equation are calculated to complete the construction of turbulence model. Based on the turbulence model, the pollutant concentration field of building decoration materials and Gauss migration model were calculated, and the migration law calculation results were obtained, and the numerical simulation model was completed. The experimental results show that the numerical simulation results of this model have high simulation accuracy and efficiency in a fixed building environment.

articleTitle: Research on trajectory tracking control of mechanical motion based on convolution neural network
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: In order to better improve the effect of mechanical motion trajectory tracking control and ensure the quality and safety of mechanical operation, a mechanical motion trajectory tracking control method based on convolution neural network is proposed. In the process of mechanical motion trajectory tracking control, due to the influence of small disturbance piecewise linear error, the mechanical system will produce multivariable nonlinear motion phenomenon in the operation process. Boundary layer tracking error is easy to occur. In order to solve the above problem, the convolution neural network is used to optimize the mechanical trajectory tracking control algorithm, and the simulation model of mechanical motion environment is established. The spatial coordinates of the trajectory are abstracted as the virtual world of genetic population, and the spatial grid structure characteristics are obtained. According to the matching conditions and parameters of convolution neural network, an error tracking integral term is designed and improved. By accurately tracking the mechanical trajectory, the accuracy of path planning and autonomous positioning is effectively improved. The experimental results show that the control method based on convolution neural network has the advantages of fast convergence speed, high accuracy and high calculation accuracy.

articleTitle: Application Method of Urban Green Space Planning Based on BIM Technology
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: In order to overcome the difficulties faced by urban green space planning in the information age, this paper proposes a novel application method of urban green space planning based on BIM technology. This application strategy fully combines the characteristics of BIM technology to improve the accuracy and feasibility of urban green space planning. Based on this, the application strategy can also fully combine the characteristics of big data technology to improve the sharing of urban green space planning data.
